title: Everyday Phrases — Running the Air Conditioner
title_quote: Too hot to sleep in this room.
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】😎 實用「調冷氣」必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡800句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 800 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Running the Air Conditioner
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用「調冷氣」情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫）。場景是悶熱的夏夜與入秋的涼晨：翻沙發墊找遙控器、裝新電池、認清雪花與太陽的模式圖示、設溫度與風速、訂好睡覺的關機時間、拆下濾網沖水晾乾、算這一個月的電費、約師傅上門加冷媒，最後天涼了切回暖氣模式。800 句循環聽，A2 程度，零基礎也能跟著開口說。常用句型包含描述冷熱與風、請家人幫忙按按鈕、詢問費用與維修時間。#英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical 'Running the Air Conditioner' phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue). The scene runs from a muggy summer night to a cool autumn morning: hunting for the remote under the sofa, fitting new batteries, reading the snowflake and sun mode icons, setting the temperature and fan speed, timing the shut-off for bed, rinsing and drying the filter mesh, working out the electric bill, booking a technician for refrigerant, and finally switching to heat when the air turns cold. 800 lines on loop, A2 level, complete beginner friendly. Useful patterns for talking about heat, wind, costs and repairs.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Too hot to sleep in this room.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu hɑt tə slip ɪn ðɪs rum/
dialogue.zh: 今晚這間房熱得睡不著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then find the remote under the fan.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn faɪnd ði rɪˈmoʊt ˈʌndər ðə fæn/
dialogue.zh: 那就到電扇底下找遙控器。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where did you leave the air conditioner remote?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr dɪd ju liv ði ɛr kənˈdɪʃənər rɪˈmoʊt/
dialogue.zh: 你把冷氣遙控器放在哪裡了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Last night it sat beside your pillow.
dialogue.phonetic: /læst naɪt ɪt sæt bɪˈsaɪd jʊr ˈpɪloʊ/
dialogue.zh: 昨晚它還在你的枕頭旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Check between the sofa cushions again.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɛk bɪˈtwin ðə ˈsoʊfə ˈkʊʃənz əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 再到沙發坐墊中間找一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nothing here, only dust and one battery.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌθɪŋ hɪr ˈoʊnli dʌst ænd wʌn ˈbætəri/
dialogue.zh: 這裡什麼都沒有，只有灰塵和一顆電池。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Those old cells died two summers ago.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðoʊz oʊld sɛlz daɪd tu ˈsʌmərz əˈɡoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 那兩顆舊電池前年夏天就沒電了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I bought a fresh pack yesterday afternoon.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ bɔt ə frɛʃ pæk ˈjɛstərdeɪ ˌæftərˈnun/
dialogue.zh: 我昨天下午買了一組新的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fetch them from the kitchen drawer, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛtʃ ðɛm frʌm ðə ˈkɪtʃən drɔr pliz/
dialogue.zh: 請從廚房抽屜把它們拿過來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The small ones or the big round ones?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə smɔl wʌnz ɔr ðə bɪɡ raʊnd wʌnz/
dialogue.zh: 小顆的，還是大的圓形那種？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Small ones with the silver tops.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɔl wʌnz wɪð ðə ˈsɪlvər tɑps/
dialogue.zh: 小顆的，頭上是銀色那種。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six in the pack, we have spares now.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ɪn ðə pæk wi hæv spɛrz naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 這一包有六顆，備用的也夠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, the remote is behind the curtain.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk ði rɪˈmoʊt ɪz bɪˈhaɪnd ðə ˈkɜrtən/
dialogue.zh: 你看，遙控器在窗簾後面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring it here and open the cover.
dialogue.phonetic: /brɪŋ ɪt hɪr ænd ˈoʊpən ðə ˈkʌvər/
dialogue.zh: 拿到這裡來，把後蓋打開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This cover is stuck, it will not slide.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈkʌvər ɪz stʌk ɪt wɪl nɑt slaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 這個蓋子卡住了，推不動。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Press the little arrow and pull gently.
dialogue.phonetic: /prɛs ðə ˈlɪtəl ˈæroʊ ænd pʊl ˈdʒɛntli/
dialogue.zh: 按住小小的箭頭再輕輕拉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Slowly, do not bend the plastic tabs.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsloʊli du nɑt bɛnd ðə ˈplæstɪk tæbz/
dialogue.zh: 慢一點，別把塑膠卡榫弄彎。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, the back door came free.
dialogue.phonetic: /gɑt ɪt ðə bæk dɔr keɪm fri/
dialogue.zh: 拿到了，後蓋鬆開了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Old batteries leak a white powder.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊld ˈbætəriz lik ə waɪt ˈpaʊdər/
dialogue.zh: 舊電池會漏出白色粉末。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wipe the metal ends with a dry cloth.
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪp ðə ˈmɛtəl ɛndz wɪð ə draɪ klɔθ/
dialogue.zh: 用乾布把金屬接點擦一擦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which side should face the spring?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ saɪd ʃud feɪs ðə sprɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 哪一端要對著彈簧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Flat side down, the bump goes outward.
dialogue.phonetic: /flæt saɪd daʊn ðə bʌmp ɡoʊz ˈaʊtwərd/
dialogue.zh: 平的那面朝下，凸起朝外面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My nails are too short for this slot.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ neɪlz ər tu ʃɔrt fɔr ðɪs slɑt/
dialogue.zh: 我指甲太短，摳不了這個小縫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try the edge of the house key.
dialogue.phonetic: /traɪ ði ɛdʒ ʌv ðə haʊs ki/
dialogue.zh: 用家門鑰匙的邊緣試試。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One cell is in, the other rolled away.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn sɛl ɪz ɪn ði ˈʌðər roʊld əˈweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 一顆進去了，另一顆滾走了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Under the bed, I see the shine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʌndər ðə bɛd aɪ si ðə ʃaɪn/
dialogue.zh: 在床底下，我看見它在反光。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hand me the small broom, the dust is thick.
dialogue.phonetic: /hænd mi ðə smɔl brum ðə dʌst ɪz θɪk/
dialogue.zh: 把小掃把遞給我，灰塵很厚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sweep near the wall, do not kick the bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /swip nɪr ðə wɔl du nɑt kɪk ðə bɛd/
dialogue.zh: 沿牆掃，別踢到床。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Both cells fit now, the cover clicks.
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ sɛlz fɪt naʊ ðə ˈkʌvər klɪks/
dialogue.zh: 兩顆都裝好了，蓋子喀一聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Press the power button and let us hear.
dialogue.phonetic: /prɛs ðə ˈpaʊər ˈbʌtən ænd lɛt ʌs hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 按下電源鍵，我們聽聽聲音。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nothing happened, the screen stays dark.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌθɪŋ ˈhæpənd ðə skrin steɪz dɑrk/
dialogue.zh: 什麼都沒有，螢幕還是黑的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe the batteries went in backwards.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi ðə ˈbætəriz wɛnt ɪn ˈbækwərdz/
dialogue.zh: 也許兩顆電池裝反了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Turn it over, look for the tiny marks.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɜrn ɪt ˈoʊvər lʊk fɔr ðə ˈtaɪni mɑrks/
dialogue.zh: 翻過來，找找小小的記號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There, a plus sign by the top end.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ə plʌs saɪn baɪ ðə tɑp ɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 在這裡，上端有一個正號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The lamp on the remote blinks once.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə læmp ɑn ðə rɪˈmoʊt blɪŋks wʌns/
dialogue.zh: 遙控器上的燈閃了一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That means it is sending a signal now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt minz ɪt ɪz ˈsɛndɪŋ ə ˈsɪɡnəl naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 那代表它現在有發出訊號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Still no sound from the air conditioner.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɪl noʊ saʊnd frʌm ði ɛr kənˈdɪʃənər/
dialogue.zh: 冷氣還是沒有任何聲音。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Point it straight at the white panel.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɔɪnt ɪt streɪt æt ðə waɪt ˈpæənəl/
dialogue.zh: 對著那塊白色面板按。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wipe that panel, a film covers the sensor.
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪp ðæt ˈpæənəl ə fɪlm ˈkʌvərz ðə ˈsɛnsər/
dialogue.zh: 擦那塊面板，感應窗蒙了一層膜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A dry cloth works better than water here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə draɪ klɔθ wɜrks ˈbɛtər ðæn ˈwɔtər hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 這種事用乾布比用水好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Press and hold the power key longer.
dialogue.phonetic: /prɛs ænd hoʊld ðə ˈpaʊər ki ˈlɔŋɡər/
dialogue.zh: 按住電源鍵久一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Beep, the flap is opening slowly.
dialogue.phonetic: /bip ðə flæp ɪz ˈoʊpənɪŋ ˈsloʊli/
dialogue.zh: 嗶一聲，風葉正在慢慢打開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cool air is finally moving through the room.
dialogue.phonetic: /kul ɛr ɪz ˈfaɪnəli ˈmuvɪŋ θru ðə rum/
dialogue.zh: 涼風終於在房間裡流動了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Turn it down, the noise hurts my ears.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɜrn ɪt daʊn ðə nɔɪz hɜrts maɪ ɪrz/
dialogue.zh: 把風轉小，這噪音吵得耳朵疼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One second, this one only changes channels.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈsɛkənd ðɪs wʌn ˈoʊnli ˈtʃeɪndʒɪz ˈtʃænəlz/
dialogue.zh: 等一下，這支只能換頻道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They look alike, but this has the fan mark.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ lʊk əˈlaɪk bʌt ðɪs hæz ðə fæn mɑrk/
dialogue.zh: 兩支長得像，但這支有風扇標誌。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tape a label on each remote tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪp ə ˈleɪbəl ɑn itʃ rɪˈmoʊt təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 今晚在每支遙控器貼上標籤。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Write air conditioner on the white sticker.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ɛr kənˈdɪʃənər ɑn ðə waɪt ˈstɪkər/
dialogue.zh: 在白色貼紙上寫冷氣兩個字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This sticker is too small for my eyes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈstɪkər ɪz tu smɔl fɔr maɪ aɪz/
dialogue.zh: 這貼紙太小，我眼睛看不清。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then use the red marker and write large.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn juz ðə rɛd ˈmɑrkər ænd raɪt lɑrdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 那就用紅筆寫大一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Batteries leak when we leave them unused.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbætəriz lik wɛn wi liv ðɛm ˌʌnˈjuzd/
dialogue.zh: 電池留著不用也會漏液。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take them out if we travel next week.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ðɛm aʊt ɪf wi ˈtrævəl nɛkst wik/
dialogue.zh: 下週出遠門就把電池取出。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep two spare cells by the front door.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip tu spɛr sɛlz baɪ ðə frʌnt dɔr/
dialogue.zh: 玄關放兩顆備用電池。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Also one box for the smoke detector.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlsoʊ wʌn bɑks fɔr ðə smoʊk dɪˈtɛktər/
dialogue.zh: 也留一盒給煙霧偵測器。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Summer power goes out most afternoons.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌmər ˈpaʊər ɡoʊz aʊt moʊst ˌæftərˈnuːnz/
dialogue.zh: 夏天常在午後跳電。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: When it returns, the remote forgets the clock.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛn ɪt rɪˈtɜrnz ðə rɪˈmoʊt fərˈɡɛts ðə klɑk/
dialogue.zh: 來電以後，遙控器會忘記時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do we keep the tiny screwdriver?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr du wi kip ðə ˈtaɪni ˈskruˌdraɪvər/
dialogue.zh: 小螺絲起子收在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Third drawer, beside the fuse box.
dialogue.phonetic: /θɜrd drɔr bɪˈsaɪd ðə fjuz bɑks/
dialogue.zh: 第三個抽屜，保險絲盒旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The battery door needs one tiny screw.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈbætəri dɔr nidz wʌn ˈtaɪni skru/
dialogue.zh: 電池蓋要鎖一顆小螺絲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tighten it gently, the thread strips fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtaɪtən ɪt ˈdʒɛntli ðə θrɛd strɪps fæst/
dialogue.zh: 輕輕鎖就好，螺紋很容易滑牙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does your phone also run the air conditioner?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz jʊr foʊn ˈɔlsoʊ rʌn ði ɛr kənˈdɪʃənər/
dialogue.zh: 你的手機也能開冷氣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only when the wifi reaches the bedroom.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli wɛn ðə ˈwaɪfaɪ ˈritʃɪz ðə ˈbɛdˌrum/
dialogue.zh: 只有網路到得了臥室才行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Download it now, the wifi dies at night.
dialogue.phonetic: /daʊnˈloʊd ɪt naʊ ðə ˈwaɪfaɪ daɪz æt naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 現在就下載，夜裡網路會斷。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It asks me to log in first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt æsks mi tə lɑɡ ɪn fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 它要我先登入帳號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Never share that password with the neighbor.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɛvər ʃɛr ðæt ˈpæswɜrd wɪð ðə ˈneɪbər/
dialogue.zh: 密碼絕對別告訴鄰居。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We will use this remote, it works fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi wɪl juz ðɪs rɪˈmoʊt ɪt wɜrks faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 我們就用這支遙控器，它能動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My fingers slipped and it fell again.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈfɪŋɡərz slɪpt ænd ɪt fɛl əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 我手指一滑，它又掉下去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look under the curtain, by the wall edge.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk ˈʌndər ðə ˈkɜrtən baɪ ðə wɔl ɛdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 到窗簾下面、牆角旁邊找。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Found it, the battery slot is empty.
dialogue.phonetic: /faʊnd ɪt ðə ˈbætəri slɑt ɪz ˈɛmpti/
dialogue.zh: 找到了，電池槽是空的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The cells fell out when it hit the floor.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə sɛlz fɛl aʊt wɛn ɪt hɪt ðə flɔr/
dialogue.zh: 撞到地板時兩顆都掉了出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rinse your hand, the powder stings a bit.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪns jʊr hænd ðə ˈpaʊdər stɪŋz ə bɪt/
dialogue.zh: 沖一下手，粉末有點刺痛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soap and water, then dry it well.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊp ænd ˈwɔtər ðɛn draɪ ɪt wɛl/
dialogue.zh: 用肥皂沖一沖再擦乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two more cells in the little drawer, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /tu mɔr sɛlz ɪn ðə ˈlɪtəl drɔr raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 小抽屜裡還有兩顆，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, four spare pairs under the sink.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs fɔr spɛr pɛrz ˈʌndər ðə sɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 對，水槽下面還有四組備用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This pair matches the size exactly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs pɛr ˈmætʃɪz ðə saɪz ɪɡˈzæktli/
dialogue.zh: 這一組尺寸剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Insert them, we will test one more time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪnˈsɜrt ðɛm wi wɪl tɛst wʌn mɔr taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 裝進去，我們再試一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two beeps mean the battery is low.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu bips min ðə ˈbætəri ɪz loʊ/
dialogue.zh: 嗶兩下代表電力不足。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ours beeps once, so it has power.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊərz bips wʌns soʊ ɪt hæz ˈpaʊər/
dialogue.zh: 我們這支只嗶一聲，還有電。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold the remote close, the signal is weak.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ðə rɪˈmoʊt kloʊs ðə ˈsɪɡnəl ɪz wik/
dialogue.zh: 把遙控器拿近一點，訊號很弱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Move the blanket pile off the panel.
dialogue.phonetic: /muv ðə ˈblæŋkɪt paɪl ɔf ðə ˈpæənəl/
dialogue.zh: 把堆著的被子從面板前拿開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wind from the vent feels like relief.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪnd frʌm ðə vɛnt filz laɪk rɪˈlif/
dialogue.zh: 出風口吹來的風真舒服。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Close the window, the cool air escapes.
dialogue.phonetic: /kloʊz ðə ˈwɪndoʊ ðə kul ɛr ɪˈskeɪps/
dialogue.zh: 窗戶要關，冷氣會跑掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Curtains too, the sun heats this wall.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɜrtənz tu ðə sʌn hits ðɪs wɔl/
dialogue.zh: 窗簾也拉上，太陽曬著這面牆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That saves power, the compressor rests more.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt seɪvz ˈpaʊər ðə kəmˈprɛʃər rɛsts mɔr/
dialogue.zh: 那樣省電，壓縮機比較不用力。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Finally, the screen shows twenty six.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfaɪnəli ðə skrin ʃoʊz ˈtwɛnti sɪks/
dialogue.zh: 終於，螢幕顯示二十六度。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty six is too warm for sleeping.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti sɪks ɪz tu wɔrm fɔr ˈslipɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 二十六度睡覺還是太熱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We will lower it after the shower.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi wɪl ˈloʊər ɪt ˈæftər ðə ˈʃaʊər/
dialogue.zh: 洗完澡我們再把它調低。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, the tiles feel cold in the bathroom.
dialogue.phonetic: /gʊd ðə taɪlz fil koʊld ɪn ðə ˈbæθrum/
dialogue.zh: 好，浴室磁磚踩起來很涼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which button made that loud click?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ ˈbʌtən meɪd ðæt laʊd klɪk/
dialogue.zh: 哪一顆按鍵發出很大的一聲？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is only the air flap moving.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ˈoʊnli ði ɛr flæp ˈmuvɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 那只是風葉在調整角度。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nothing else works, only the fan runs.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌθɪŋ ɛls wɜrks ˈoʊnli ðə fæn rʌnz/
dialogue.zh: 其他都沒動，只有風扇在轉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cooling starts two minutes after the fan.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkulɪŋ stɑrts tu ˈmɪnɪts ˈæftər ðə fæn/
dialogue.zh: 冷氣會在風扇之後兩分鐘才啟動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Icons on the screen are very small.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaɪkɑnz ɑn ðə skrin ər ˈvɛri smɔl/
dialogue.zh: 螢幕上的圖案非常小。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put on your glasses and read them with me.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊt ɑn jʊr ˈɡlæsɪz ænd rid ðɛm wɪð mi/
dialogue.zh: 戴上眼鏡，跟我一起唸出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Snowflake first, then a drop, then a star.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsnoʊfleɪk fɜrst ðɛn ə drɑp ðɛn ə stɑr/
dialogue.zh: 先是雪花，再是水滴，然後是星星。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let us learn what each little shape means.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs lɜrn wʌt itʃ ˈlɪtəl ʃeɪp minz/
dialogue.zh: 我們來認清楚每個小圖案。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My eyes are tired, tell me tomorrow.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ aɪz ər ˈtaɪərd tɛl mi təˈmɑroʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我眼睛累了，明天再跟我說。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sleep first, the cool air will stay on.
dialogue.phonetic: /slip fɜrst ðə kul ɛr wɪl steɪ ɑn/
dialogue.zh: 先睡吧，冷氣會一直開著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Leave the remote on the night table.
dialogue.phonetic: /liv ðə rɪˈmoʊt ɑn ðə naɪt ˈteɪbəl/
dialogue.zh: 把遙控器放在床頭櫃上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will set the timer before I lie down.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl sɛt ðə ˈtaɪmər bɪˈfɔr aɪ laɪ daʊn/
dialogue.zh: 躺下前我先把定時設好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Snowflake means cooling, nothing else.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsnoʊfleɪk minz ˈkulɪŋ ˈnʌθɪŋ ɛls/
dialogue.zh: 雪花就是冷氣，別的都不是。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dry mode shows a falling water drop.
dialogue.phonetic: /draɪ moʊd ʃoʊz ə ˈfɔlɪŋ ˈwɔtər drɑp/
dialogue.zh: 除濕模式是一顆往下掉的水滴。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What does the small sun do in July?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt dʌz ðə smɔl sʌn du ɪn dʒʊˈlaɪ/
dialogue.zh: 小太陽圖案在七月是做什麼的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It heats, so keep it off until winter.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt hits soʊ kip ɪt ɔf ʌnˈtɪl ˈwɪntər/
dialogue.zh: 那個是暖氣，冬天前別按到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Auto mode picks the work for us.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔtoʊ moʊd pɪks ðə wɜrk fɔr ʌs/
dialogue.zh: 自動模式會幫我們選運轉方式。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It holds the room near twenty five.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt hoʊldz ðə rum nɪr ˈtwɛnti faɪv/
dialogue.zh: 它把室溫抓在二十五度左右。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fan only, does that cool the air?
dialogue.phonetic: /fæn ˈoʊnli dʌz ðæt kul ði ɛr/
dialogue.zh: 只有風扇，那樣會讓空氣變涼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it just moves air like a fan.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ɪt dʒʌst muvz ɛr laɪk ə fæn/
dialogue.zh: 不會，它只是像電扇一樣吹風。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dry mode feels cool without strong wind.
dialogue.phonetic: /draɪ moʊd filz kul wɪˈðaʊt strɔŋ wɪnd/
dialogue.zh: 除濕模式不強吹卻覺得涼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It pulls water from the air slowly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt pʊlz ˈwɔtər frʌm ði ɛr ˈsloʊli/
dialogue.zh: 它慢慢地把空氣裡的水抽走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The walls stay wet in a rainy week.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə wɔlz steɪ wɛt ɪn ə ˈreɪni wik/
dialogue.zh: 下雨那一週牆壁都是濕的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Run dry mode two hours every afternoon.
dialogue.phonetic: /rʌn draɪ moʊd tu ˈaʊərz ˈɛvri ˌæftərˈnun/
dialogue.zh: 每天下午開除濕兩個小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sleep mode looks like a small moon.
dialogue.phonetic: /slip moʊd lʊks laɪk ə smɔl mun/
dialogue.zh: 睡眠模式看起來像一個小月亮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It raises the heat while you sleep.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt reɪzɪz ðə hit waɪl ju slip/
dialogue.zh: 它會在你睡著後把溫度調高。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why does it rise instead of staying flat?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ dʌz ɪt raɪz ɪnˈstɛd ʌv ˈsteɪɪŋ flæt/
dialogue.zh: 為什麼會升高而不是一直固定？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your body gets cold deep into the night.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr ˈbɑdi ɡɛts koʊld dip ˈɪntu ðə naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 熟睡以後人的身體會變涼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Swing moves the flap up and down.
dialogue.phonetic: /swɪŋ muvz ðə flæp ʌp ænd daʊn/
dialogue.zh: 擺風會讓風葉上下掃動。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Point it away from my head tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɔɪnt ɪt əˈweɪ frʌm maɪ hɛd təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 今晚別讓風掃到我的頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Turbo is loud but it cools fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtɜrboʊ ɪz laʊd bʌt ɪt kuls fæst/
dialogue.zh: 急速模式很吵但降溫很快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use it only when we come home hot.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ɪt ˈoʊnli wɛn wi kʌm hoʊm hɑt/
dialogue.zh: 只在滿身汗回家的時候用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Quiet mode suits a light sleeper best.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkwaɪət moʊd suts ə laɪt ˈslipər bɛst/
dialogue.zh: 安靜模式最適合淺眠的人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It cuts the wind to the lowest step.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt kʌts ðə wɪnd tə ðə ˈloʊɪst stɛp/
dialogue.zh: 它把風量降到最低那一段。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is that lock shape on the corner?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪz ðæt lɑk ʃeɪp ɑn ðə ˈkɔrnər/
dialogue.zh: 角落那個小鎖圖案是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It freezes the buttons, children press everything.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈfrizɪz ðə ˈbʌtənz ˈtʃɪldrən prɛs ˈɛvriθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 那會鎖住按鍵，小孩什麼都按。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold lock three seconds, then let go.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld lɑk θri ˈsɛkəndz ðɛn lɛt ɡoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 鎖定鍵按三秒再放開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Show me again, I locked it by mistake.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃoʊ mi əˈɡɛn aɪ lɑkt ɪt baɪ mɪsˈteɪk/
dialogue.zh: 再示範一次，我不小心鎖到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A red lamp says clean the filter.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə rɛd læmp sɛz klin ðə ˈfɪltər/
dialogue.zh: 紅燈亮起是在叫我們清濾網。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How many hours does that lamp count?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni ˈaʊərz dʌz ðæt læmp kaʊnt/
dialogue.zh: 那盞燈是在計算多少小時？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: About three hundred, then it glows.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈbaʊt θri ˈhʌndrəd ðɛn ɪt ɡloʊz/
dialogue.zh: 大約三百小時才會亮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wash the mesh and reset that light.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑʃ ðə mɛʃ ænd riˈsɛt ðæt laɪt/
dialogue.zh: 洗過網片再把燈歸零。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does your screen read Celsius or Fahrenheit?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz jʊr skrin rid ˈsɛlsəs ɔr fəˈrenhaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 你的螢幕是攝氏還是華氏？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine shows a number and a small letter.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn ʃoʊz ə ˈnʌmbər ænd ə smɔl ˈlɛtər/
dialogue.zh: 我那支是一個數字加一個小字母。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Change it back, I count in Celsius.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃeɪndʒ ɪt bæk aɪ kaʊnt ɪn ˈsɛlsəs/
dialogue.zh: 換回去吧，我習慣用攝氏。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold both fan keys, then it flips over.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld boʊθ fæn kiz ðɛn ɪt flɪps ˈoʊvər/
dialogue.zh: 同時按住兩顆風鍵就會換過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Every icon has a word under it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvri ˈaɪkɑn hæz ə wɜrd ˈʌndər ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 每個圖案下面都有一個字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The words faded, the plastic is old.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə wɜrdz ˈfeɪdɪd ðə ˈplæstɪk ɪz oʊld/
dialogue.zh: 字都磨淡了，塑膠太舊了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I taped a paper guide beside the screen.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ teɪpt ə ˈpeɪpər ɡaɪd bɪˈsaɪd ðə skrin/
dialogue.zh: 我在螢幕旁貼了一張說明單。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart, now we can name each shape.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑrt naʊ wi kæn neɪm itʃ ʃeɪp/
dialogue.zh: 聰明，現在每個圖案都有名字了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Press the light key, the screen glows blue.
dialogue.phonetic: /prɛs ðə laɪt ki ðə skrin ɡloʊz blu/
dialogue.zh: 按燈鍵，螢幕亮出藍光。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It fades in ten seconds, no need to worry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt feɪdz ɪn tɛn ˈsɛkəndz noʊ nid tə ˈwɜri/
dialogue.zh: 十秒後自己會暗，不用擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which mark shows the wind direction?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ mɑrk ʃoʊz ðə wɪnd dəˈrɛkʃən/
dialogue.zh: 哪個記號表示吹風的方向？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The one with three curved arrows.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə wʌn wɪθ θri kɜrvd ˈæroʊz/
dialogue.zh: 三個彎箭頭那一個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three bars stand for the strongest wind.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri bɑrz stænd fɔr ðə ˈstrɔŋəst wɪnd/
dialogue.zh: 三格代表最強的一段風。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One thin bar means almost no sound.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn θɪn bɑr minz ˈɔlmoʊst noʊ saʊnd/
dialogue.zh: 一格細線就幾乎沒有聲音。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This fan shape spins on the screen.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs fæn ʃeɪp spɪnz ɑn ðə skrin/
dialogue.zh: 這個風扇圖案在螢幕上轉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Spinning means auto wind, not fixed speed.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈspɪnɪŋ minz ˈɔtoʊ wɪnd nɑt fɪkst spid/
dialogue.zh: 會轉就是自動風，不是固定風速。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why does a snowflake blink for a while?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ dʌz ə ˈsnoʊfleɪk blɪŋk fɔr ə waɪl/
dialogue.zh: 為什麼雪花會先閃好一下子？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The compressor waits three minutes to start.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kəmˈprɛʃər weɪts θri ˈmɪnɪts tə stɑrt/
dialogue.zh: 壓縮機要等三分鐘才能啟動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not press again while it blinks.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt prɛs əˈɡɛn waɪl ɪt blɪŋks/
dialogue.zh: 閃爍的時候別再按第二次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I waited, and now the cold wind comes.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈweɪtɪd ænd naʊ ðə koʊld wɪnd kʌmz/
dialogue.zh: 我等了，現在涼風吹出來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One small word marks the cool mode here.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn smɔl wɜrd mɑrks ðə kul moʊd hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 這裡的冷氣模式是一個小單字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Spell it out, I cannot read tiny print.
dialogue.phonetic: /spɛl ɪt aʊt aɪ ˈkɑnɑt rid ˈtaɪni prɪnt/
dialogue.zh: 唸出來給我聽，小字我看不清。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It reads cool in four English letters.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ridz kul ɪn fɔr ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ˈlɛtərz/
dialogue.zh: 冷氣那一個字是四個字母拼成的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And dry mode has three letters there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd draɪ moʊd hæz θri ˈlɛtərz ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 除濕在那邊是三個字母。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Energy saving shows a small leaf.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛnərdʒi ˈseɪvɪŋ ʃoʊz ə smɔl lif/
dialogue.zh: 節能是一片小葉子的圖案。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It stops the compressor from working hard.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt stɑps ðə kəmˈprɛʃər frʌm ˈwɜrkɪŋ hɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 它讓壓縮機不用使那麼大的力。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fresh air pulls wind from outside.
dialogue.phonetic: /frɛʃ ɛr pʊlz wɪnd frʌm ˌaʊtˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 換氣是把外面的風拉進來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our window unit carries no such shape.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər ˈwɪndoʊ ˈjunɪt ˈkæriz noʊ sʌtʃ ʃeɪp/
dialogue.zh: 我們那台窗型機沒有這個圖案。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One line shows time, one shows heat.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn laɪn ʃoʊz taɪm wʌn ʃoʊz hit/
dialogue.zh: 一行顯示時間，一行顯示溫度。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Set both after you change the cells.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛt boʊθ ˈæftər ju tʃeɪndʒ ðə sɛlz/
dialogue.zh: 換完電池再一起調這兩行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One key changes mode over and over.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ki ˈtʃeɪndʒɪz moʊd ˈoʊvər ænd ˈoʊvər/
dialogue.zh: 有一顆鍵會不斷輪流換模式。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Press once per shape, then stop.
dialogue.phonetic: /prɛs wʌns pɜr ʃeɪp ðɛn stɑp/
dialogue.zh: 每個圖案按一次就停下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stop at snowflake, we want cooling now.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɑp æt ˈsnoʊfleɪk wi wɑnt ˈkulɪŋ naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 停在雪花，我們現在要冷氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, the unit hums and blows cold.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn ði ˈjunɪt hʌmz ænd bloʊz koʊld/
dialogue.zh: 好了，主機嗡嗡地吹涼風。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A tiny dot means the timer is set.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈtaɪni dɑt minz ðə ˈtaɪmər ɪz sɛt/
dialogue.zh: 一個小圓點代表定時設好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check twice, last night it ran until morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɛk twaɪs læst naɪt ɪt ræn ʌnˈtɪl ˈmɔrnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 多確認一次，昨晚它吹到早上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wind hits my shoulder when the flap rests low.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪnd hɪts maɪ ˈʃoʊldər wɛn ðə flæp rɛsts loʊ/
dialogue.zh: 風葉往下停時會吹到我的肩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lift it, the flap stops at any angle.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɪft ɪt ðə flæp stɑps æt ˈɛni ˈæŋɡəl/
dialogue.zh: 往上調，風葉能停在任何角度。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold the swing key to freeze the angle.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ðə swɪŋ ki tə friz ði ˈæŋɡəl/
dialogue.zh: 長按擺風鍵就能固定角度。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, the bed gets soft wind now.
dialogue.phonetic: /gʊd ðə bɛd ɡɛts sɔft wɪnd naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 很好，床這裡只吹到柔風。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nothing moves, the flap stays shut.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌθɪŋ muvz ðə flæp steɪz ʃʌt/
dialogue.zh: 都沒有動，風葉還閉著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It opens only after the cooling starts.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈoʊpənz ˈoʊnli ˈæftər ðə ˈkulɪŋ stɑrts/
dialogue.zh: 要等冷氣開始運轉它才會開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Press the snowflake, not the fan shape.
dialogue.phonetic: /prɛs ðə ˈsnoʊfleɪk nɑt ðə fæn ʃeɪp/
dialogue.zh: 按雪花，不是按風扇那個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sorry, my thumb slid to the wrong key.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɑri maɪ θʌm slɪd tə ðə rɔŋ ki/
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，我拇指滑到錯的鍵了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A star shape means it cleans itself.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə stɑr ʃeɪp minz ɪt klinz ɪtˈsɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 星星圖案是自我清潔。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It dries the inside after we switch off.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt draɪz ði ɪnˈsaɪd ˈæftər wi swɪtʃ ɔf/
dialogue.zh: 關機後它會把內部烘乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let it run ten minutes before sleep.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ɪt rʌn tɛn ˈmɪnɪts bɪˈfɔr slip/
dialogue.zh: 睡前先讓它吹十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The walls must lose the heat they saved.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə wɔlz mʌst luz ðə hit ðeɪ seɪvd/
dialogue.zh: 牆壁要把存來的熱散掉才行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Every mode carries a number on the guide.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvri moʊd ˈkæriz ə ˈnʌmbər ɑn ðə ɡaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 說明單上每個模式都有編號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Numbers match the list you taped there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌmbərz mætʃ ðə lɪst ju teɪpt ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 編號跟你貼的那張對得起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is that paper guide right now?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ɪz ðæt ˈpeɪpər ɡaɪd raɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 那張說明單現在在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A photo of it sleeps in my phone.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈfoʊtoʊ ʌv ɪt slips ɪn maɪ foʊn/
dialogue.zh: 我手機裡存了一張它的照片。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Zoom in, the print looks very thin.
dialogue.phonetic: /zum ɪn ðə prɪnt lʊks ˈvɛri θɪn/
dialogue.zh: 放大一點，那行字印得很淡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, dry mode runs on the slow fan.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr draɪ moʊd rʌnz ɑn ðə sloʊ fæn/
dialogue.zh: 這裡寫除濕是用慢風運轉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cold air drops, so point the flap high.
dialogue.phonetic: /koʊld ɛr drɑps soʊ pɔɪnt ðə flæp haɪ/
dialogue.zh: 涼空氣往下沉，風葉要朝上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the room cools without a draft.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðə rum kuls wɪˈðaʊt ə dræft/
dialogue.zh: 這樣整間涼卻不會直沖人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Warm air rises from the kitchen door.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔrm ɛr ˈraɪzɪz frʌm ðə ˈkɪtʃən dɔr/
dialogue.zh: 暖風從廚房門口飄過來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Shut it, the cool stays inside better.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʌt ɪt ðə kul steɪz ɪnˈsaɪd ˈbɛtər/
dialogue.zh: 關起來，涼氣才留得住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My feet are cold, my back is wet.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ fit ər koʊld maɪ bæk ɪz wɛt/
dialogue.zh: 腳是冷的，背卻是濕的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wet air feels like that, run dry mode.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛt ɛr filz laɪk ðæt rʌn draɪ moʊd/
dialogue.zh: 空氣太濕就是這種感覺，開除濕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long can dry mode run at night?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ kæn draɪ moʊd rʌn æt naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 除濕模式一夜能開多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: All night, it stops when the tray fills.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl naɪt ɪt stɑps wɛn ðə treɪ fɪlz/
dialogue.zh: 整夜都行，水盤滿了會自己停。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A dripping sound means a full tray.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈdrɪpɪŋ saʊnd minz ə fʊl treɪ/
dialogue.zh: 有滴水的聲音就是水盤滿了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pour it out and wipe the rim dry.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɔr ɪt aʊt ænd waɪp ðə rɪm draɪ/
dialogue.zh: 倒掉再把邊緣擦乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Never wash the remote with water.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɛvər wɑʃ ðə rɪˈmoʊt wɪθ ˈwɔtər/
dialogue.zh: 遙控器絕對不能用水洗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only a barely damp cloth on it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ə ˈbɛrli dæmp klɔθ ɑn ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 只能用幾乎乾的布擦一擦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the small marks make sense to me.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə smɔl mɑrks meɪk sɛns tə mi/
dialogue.zh: 現在這些小記號我看得懂了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Say them back, then I know you know.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪ ðɛm bæk ðɛn aɪ noʊ ju noʊ/
dialogue.zh: 唸一次給我聽，我就知道你記住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shape by shape, you learned the screen.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃeɪp baɪ ʃeɪp ju lɜrnd ðə skrin/
dialogue.zh: 一個圖案一個圖案，你都認得了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tomorrow we set the heat and the wind.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈmɑroʊ wi sɛt ðə hit ænd ðə wɪnd/
dialogue.zh: 明天再來調溫度和風量。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twenty two feels cold on bare skin.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti tu filz koʊld ɑn bɛr skɪn/
dialogue.zh: 二十二度吹著裸露的皮膚會冷。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cover your shoulders and set twenty five.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkʌvər jʊr ˈʃoʊldərz ænd sɛt ˈtwɛnti faɪv/
dialogue.zh: 蓋好肩膀，先把溫度設在二十五。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Each press moves the number by one.
dialogue.phonetic: /itʃ prɛs muvz ðə ˈnʌmbər baɪ wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 每按一次，數字變一度。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold the key and it counts fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ðə ki ænd ɪt kaʊnts fæst/
dialogue.zh: 按住鍵就會快速連續變。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lowest step on this model is eighteen.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈloʊɪst stɛp ɑn ðɪs ˈmɑdəl ɪz ˌeɪˈtin/
dialogue.zh: 這型冷氣最低只能設到十八度。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eighteen will freeze us before dawn.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌeɪˈtin wɪl friz ʌs bɪˈfɔr dɔn/
dialogue.zh: 十八度會讓我們在天亮前凍醒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Raise it two steps, my toes hurt.
dialogue.phonetic: /reɪz ɪt tu stɛps maɪ toʊz hɜrt/
dialogue.zh: 調高兩格，我的腳趾都冷了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cold toes mean the wind aims at you.
dialogue.phonetic: /koʊld toʊz min ðə wɪnd eɪmz æt ju/
dialogue.zh: 腳趾冷代表風正對著你吹。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What number do doctors suggest for sleep?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ˈnʌmbər du ˈdɑktərz səɡˈdʒɛst fɔr slip/
dialogue.zh: 醫生建議睡覺時設幾度？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About twenty five with a thin blanket.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈbaʊt ˈtwɛnti faɪv wɪð ə θɪn ˈblæŋkɪt/
dialogue.zh: 大約二十五度，再蓋一條薄被。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wind at level three dries my throat.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪnd æt ˈlɛvəl θri draɪz maɪ θroʊt/
dialogue.zh: 三檔風吹得我喉嚨乾乾的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Level two, and leave water on the table.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɛvəl tu ænd liv ˈwɔtər ɑn ðə ˈteɪbəl/
dialogue.zh: 改成二檔，床頭放一杯水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wind feels softer near the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪnd filz ˈsɔftər nɪr ðə dɔr/
dialogue.zh: 靠近門那邊風比較柔。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Heat floats up, cool air stays low.
dialogue.phonetic: /hit floʊts ʌp kul ɛr steɪz loʊ/
dialogue.zh: 熱氣往上浮，涼的沉在下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Move the bed away from the vent.
dialogue.phonetic: /muv ðə bɛd əˈweɪ frʌm ðə vɛnt/
dialogue.zh: 把床移離出風口那裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We cannot lift it, point the flap up.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ˈkɑnɑt lɪft ɪt pɔɪnt ðə flæp ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 我們抬不動，把風葉朝上調就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wind speed has three steps on this remote.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪnd spid hæz θri stɛps ɑn ðɪs rɪˈmoʊt/
dialogue.zh: 這支遙控器的風速分三段。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Auto wind chooses the step itself.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔtoʊ wɪnd ˈtʃuzɪz ðə stɛp ɪtˈsɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 自動風會自己挑要哪一段。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Low wind keeps the room quiet.
dialogue.phonetic: /loʊ wɪnd kips ðə rum ˈkwaɪət/
dialogue.zh: 低風讓房間保持安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But cooling takes a long time then.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌt ˈkulɪŋ teɪks ə lɔŋ taɪm ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 不過那樣降溫就要很久。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: High wind drops the heat quickly.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ wɪnd drɑps ðə hit ˈkwɪkli/
dialogue.zh: 強風一下子就把熱氣打下去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then it feels damp again at three.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ɪt filz dæmp əˈɡɛn æt θri/
dialogue.zh: 可是凌晨三點又覺得黏膩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Set the number before you climb in.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛt ðə ˈnʌmbər bɪˈfɔr ju klaɪm ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 鑽進被窩前先把溫度設好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I always hit the wrong key at night.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈɔlweɪz hɪt ðə rɔŋ ki ət naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我總是在夜裡按錯按鍵。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Room stays warm after thirty whole minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /rum steɪz wɔrm ˈæftər ˈθɜrti hoʊl ˈmɪnɪts/
dialogue.zh: 三十分鐘過了，房間還是溫的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The window is open, close it first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈwɪndoʊ ɪz ˈoʊpən kloʊz ɪt fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 窗戶開著耶，先把它關起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the door shut? Cool air leaks out.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə dɔr ʃʌt kul ɛr likz aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 門關好了嗎？冷氣會漏出去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A rolled towel stops that draft now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə roʊld ˈtaʊəl stɑps ðæt dræft naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 捲一條毛巾塞門底就擋住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sunlight bakes this wall until evening.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌnˌlaɪt beɪks ðɪs wɔl ʌnˈtɪl ˈivənɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 這面牆被曬到傍晚才停。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So the room stays warm past midnight.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðə rum steɪz wɔrm pæst ˈmɪdˌnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 所以過了午夜房間還是不涼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I lower the number for night?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ ˈloʊər ðə ˈnʌmbər fɔr naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 入睡前要把溫度調低嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Raise it a little after midnight instead.
dialogue.phonetic: /reɪz ɪt ə ˈlɪtəl ˈæftər ˈmɪdˌnaɪt ɪnˈstɛd/
dialogue.zh: 反而要在半夜往上調一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twenty eight will not feel cold at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti eɪt wɪl nɑt fil koʊld æt ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 二十八度完全不會有涼感。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So two slow fans may be enough.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ tu sloʊ fænz meɪ bi ɪˈnʌf/
dialogue.zh: 那開兩台慢電扇也許就夠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My legs ache when the wind bites.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ lɛɡz eɪk wɛn ðə wɪnd baɪts/
dialogue.zh: 冷風一刺，我的腿就痠痛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Long socks fix that, keep the number high.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɔŋ sɑks fɪks ðæt kip ðə ˈnʌmbər haɪ/
dialogue.zh: 穿長襪就能解決，溫度別調太低。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fan hum changes with every step.
dialogue.phonetic: /fæn hʌm ˈtʃeɪndʒɪz wɪð ˈɛvri stɛp/
dialogue.zh: 每換一檔，風扇的嗡聲都不同。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Listen, the high step sounds rough.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɪsən ðə haɪ stɛp saʊndz rʌf/
dialogue.zh: 你聽，最高那檔聲音很粗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rough wind wakes the baby in the hall.
dialogue.phonetic: /rʌf wɪnd weɪks ðə ˈbeɪbi ɪn ðə hɔl/
dialogue.zh: 風太粗會把客廳的寶寶吵醒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring the baby here, this side stays quiet.
dialogue.phonetic: /brɪŋ ðə ˈbeɪbi hɪr ðɪs saɪd steɪz ˈkwaɪət/
dialogue.zh: 把寶寶抱過來，這一側比較安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which step gives wind with no sound?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ stɛp ɡɪvz wɪnd wɪð noʊ saʊnd/
dialogue.zh: 哪一段有風卻幾乎沒聲音？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The lowest, it sounds like slow breathing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈloʊɪst ɪt saʊndz laɪk sloʊ ˈbriðɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 最低那段，像慢慢呼吸一樣輕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Silent mode leaves one mark on screen.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsaɪlənt moʊd livz wʌn mɑrk ɑn skrin/
dialogue.zh: 靜音模式在螢幕上只留一個記號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Does the compressor rest in that mode?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə kəmˈprɛʃər rɛst ɪn ðæt moʊd/
dialogue.zh: 那種模式下壓縮機會休息嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It runs slow, so the room cools late.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt rʌnz sloʊ soʊ ðə rum kuls leɪt/
dialogue.zh: 它轉得慢，房間就涼得慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But the electric bill gets smaller too.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌt ði ɪˈlɛktrɪk bɪl ɡɛts ˈsmɔlər tu/
dialogue.zh: 可是電費單也會跟著變小。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cool air makes us sleepy in minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /kul ɛr meɪks ʌs ˈslipi ɪn ˈmɪnɪts/
dialogue.zh: 涼空氣讓我們幾分鐘就想睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sleepy is all we want right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈslipi ɪz ɔl wi wɑnt raɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我們現在要的就是有睡意。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Push the vent fully up for tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊʃ ðə vɛnt ˈfʊli ʌp fɔr təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 今晚把出風口完全朝上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the air rides along the ceiling.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ði ɛr raɪdz əˈlɔŋ ðə ˈsilɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 這樣風就沿著天花板走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Still twenty seven on the screen.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɪl ˈtwɛnti ˈsɛvən ɑn ðə skrin/
dialogue.zh: 螢幕上還是二十七度。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Press down twice and wait for the beep.
dialogue.phonetic: /prɛs daʊn twaɪs ænd weɪt fɔr ðə bip/
dialogue.zh: 往下按兩次，等那聲嗶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One beep means it took the new number.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn bip minz ɪt tʊk ðə nju ˈnʌmbər/
dialogue.zh: 嗶一聲就表示它收到新數字了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now it shows twenty five, that is right.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ɪt ʃoʊz ˈtwɛnti faɪv ðæt ɪz raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 現在顯示二十五度，對了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wind feels cool here, not hard.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪnd filz kul hɪr nɑt hɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 這裡的風是涼的，但不強。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Leave it, my neck thanks you already.
dialogue.phonetic: /liv ɪt maɪ nɛk θæŋks ju ɔlˈrɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 就這樣吧，我的脖子已經在感謝你了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A small fan helps the cold spread.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə smɔl fæn hɛlps ðə koʊld sprɛd/
dialogue.zh: 小電扇能幫涼風散到全室。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Face it to the wall, never at us.
dialogue.phonetic: /feɪs ɪt tə ðə wɔl ˈnɛvər æt ʌs/
dialogue.zh: 叫它對著作牆，別對著人吹。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Walls hold the cool until dawn.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔlz hoʊld ðə kul ʌnˈtɪl dɔn/
dialogue.zh: 牆會把涼意留到天亮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So we can switch it off at five.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wi kæn swɪtʃ ɪt ɔf æt faɪv/
dialogue.zh: 那五點就可以把它關掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My skin feels tight in this dry wind.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ skɪn filz taɪt ɪn ðɪs draɪ wɪnd/
dialogue.zh: 風太乾，我的皮膚繃繃的不舒服。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Set a bowl of water by the bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛt ə boʊl ʌv ˈwɔtər baɪ ðə bɛd/
dialogue.zh: 床邊放一盆水就會好一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hang a damp cloth over the chair back.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæŋ ə dæmp klɔθ ˈoʊvər ðə tʃɛr bæk/
dialogue.zh: 把微濕的布掛在椅背上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It adds wetness while the wind passes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ædz ˈwɛtnɪs waɪl ðə wɪnd ˈpæsɪz/
dialogue.zh: 風一吹過去，就順帶補一點濕氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Screen light wakes me at three again.
dialogue.phonetic: /skrin laɪt weɪks mi æt θri əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 凌晨三點螢幕光會把我照醒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is a dim key on the left side.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə dɪm ki ɑn ðə lɛft saɪd/
dialogue.zh: 左邊有一顆調暗燈光的鍵。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Press it and the glow goes away.
dialogue.phonetic: /prɛs ɪt ænd ðə ɡloʊ ɡoʊz əˈweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 按一下，那圈光就不見了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dark plus cold, now I can rest.
dialogue.phonetic: /dɑrk plʌs koʊld naʊ aɪ kən rɛst/
dialogue.zh: 又黑又涼，這下我能睡了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two degrees more will not wake me.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu dɪˈɡriz mɔr wɪl nɑt weɪk mi/
dialogue.zh: 多兩度就不會把我冷醒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, I hate the middle of the night chill.
dialogue.phonetic: /gʊd aɪ heɪt ðə ˈmɪdəl ʌv ðə naɪt tʃɪl/
dialogue.zh: 好，我最討厭半夜那陣寒意。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This reading is room heat, not my setting.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈridɪŋ ɪz rum hit nɑt maɪ ˈsɛtɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 螢幕顯示的是室溫，不是我設的度數。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Room heat falls slowly, wait a bit longer.
dialogue.phonetic: /rum hit fɔlz ˈsloʊli weɪt ə bɪt ˈlɔŋɡər/
dialogue.zh: 室溫降得慢，再等一會兒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Room reads twenty nine, give it time.
dialogue.phonetic: /rum ridz ˈtwɛnti naɪn ɡɪv ɪt taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 室溫二十九度，給它一點時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten minutes, then the wind feels different.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn ˈmɪnɪts ðɛn ðə wɪnd filz ˈdɪfərənt/
dialogue.zh: 十分鐘後，風的感覺就不一樣了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wind from the vent carries a smell.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪnd frʌm ðə vɛnt ˈkæriz ə smɛl/
dialogue.zh: 出風口的風帶著一股味道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Old wet dust, we must clean the mesh.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊld wɛt dʌst wi mʌst klin ðə mɛʃ/
dialogue.zh: 是積久的濕灰塵，得清濾網了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cleaning can wait until the weekend morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈklinɪŋ kæn weɪt ʌnˈtɪl ði ˈwikˌɛnd ˈmɔrnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 清洗可以等到週末早上再做。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then Saturday morning, before the house wakes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ˈsætərˌdeɪ ˈmɔrnɪŋ bɪˈfɔr ðə haʊs weɪks/
dialogue.zh: 那就星期六早上，趁屋裡還沒有人醒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Set the wind to medium while we talk.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛt ðə wɪnd tə ˈmidiəm waɪl wi tɔk/
dialogue.zh: 我們說話時先把風設在中段。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Medium is enough for a warm night.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmidiəm ɪz ɪˈnʌf fɔr ə wɔrm naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 這種暖夜用中段剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cold air and hot soup, that is summer.
dialogue.phonetic: /koʊld ɛr ænd hɑt sup ðæt ɪz ˈsʌmər/
dialogue.zh: 涼空氣配熱湯，這才是夏天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will bring the bowls to the bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl brɪŋ ðə boʊlz tə ðə bɛd/
dialogue.zh: 我把碗拿到床邊來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Careful, the floor is slick with water.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɛrfəl ðə flɔr ɪz slɪk wɪθ ˈwɔtər/
dialogue.zh: 小心，地板被水弄得滑滑的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wipe it now, the wind dries it fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪp ɪt naʊ ðə wɪnd draɪz ɪt fæst/
dialogue.zh: 馬上擦，風一吹很快就乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wind dries the floor in a few minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪnd draɪz ðə flɔr ɪn ə fju ˈmɪnɪts/
dialogue.zh: 風幾分鐘就把地板吹乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the wet smell leaves the room.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðə wɛt smɛl livz ðə rum/
dialogue.zh: 那樣濕味也會從房間消失。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My nose runs when the air is cold.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ noʊz rʌnz wɛn ði ɛr ɪz koʊld/
dialogue.zh: 空氣一冷我的鼻子就流不停。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is normal, keep the number at twenty seven.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ˈnɔrməl kip ðə ˈnʌmbər æt ˈtwɛnti ˈsɛvən/
dialogue.zh: 很正常，溫度保持在二十七就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twenty seven with a sheet feels fair.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti ˈsɛvən wɪð ə ʃit filz fɛr/
dialogue.zh: 二十七度蓋一條薄單剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fair for you, my feet need wool socks.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛr fɔr ju maɪ fit nid wʊl sɑks/
dialogue.zh: 你剛好，我的腳要穿毛襪。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wool socks indoors sound strange to me.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊl sɑks ˌɪnˈdɔrz saʊnd streɪndʒ tə mi/
dialogue.zh: 在室內穿毛襪我覺得很奇怪。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try one night, then thank the cold air.
dialogue.phonetic: /traɪ wʌn naɪt ðɛn θæŋk ðə koʊld ɛr/
dialogue.zh: 試穿一晚，你就會感謝涼空氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more thing, the wind points too high.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr θɪŋ ðə wɪnd pɔɪnts tu haɪ/
dialogue.zh: 還有一件事，風向上跑太高了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lower it one notch, the flap stops there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈloʊər ɪt wʌn nɑtʃ ðə flæp stɑps ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 往下調一格，風葉就停在那。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Notch by notch, we find the good angle.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑtʃ baɪ nɑtʃ wi faɪnd ðə gʊd ˈæŋɡəl/
dialogue.zh: 一格一格試，就能找到最好的角度。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There, cool air on the chest, soft wind.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr kul ɛr ɑn ðə tʃɛst sɔft wɪnd/
dialogue.zh: 這裡，涼風溫柔地碰到胸口。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect number, perfect wind, finally.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt ˈnʌmbər ˈpɜrfɪkt wɪnd ˈfaɪnəli/
dialogue.zh: 完美的溫度，完美的風，終於搞定了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now set the hour when it shuts down.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ sɛt ði ˈaʊər wɛn ɪt ʃʌts daʊn/
dialogue.zh: 接著把關機的那個小時設好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Timer first, then we both sleep well.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtaɪmər fɜrst ðɛn wi boʊθ slip wɛl/
dialogue.zh: 先設定時，我們兩個才睡得安穩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Find the clock key, it sits near the bottom.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪnd ðə klɑk ki ɪt sɪts nɪr ðə ˈbɑtəm/
dialogue.zh: 找時鐘那顆鍵，在遙控器下方。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This key sets how many hours it runs.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ki sɛts haʊ ˈmɛni ˈaʊərz ɪt rʌnz/
dialogue.zh: 這顆鍵設定它一共吹幾個小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Press it and a clock appears on the line.
dialogue.phonetic: /prɛs ɪt ænd ə klɑk əˈpɪrz ɑn ðə laɪn/
dialogue.zh: 按下去，數字行會跳出一個時鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many hours until it stops itself?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni ˈaʊərz ʌnˈtɪl ɪt stɑps ɪtˈsɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 設幾小時以後它會自己停？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Half an hour, then one, then two.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf ən ˈaʊər ðɛn wʌn ðɛn tu/
dialogue.zh: 半小時，接著一小時、兩小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two hours fits my sleep pattern best.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈaʊərz fɪts maɪ slip ˈpætərn bɛst/
dialogue.zh: 兩小時最合我的睡眠節奏。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That keeps cool air past midnight then.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt kips kul ɛr pæst ˈmɪdˌnaɪt ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 那樣房間就能涼過午夜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about waking us before seven?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt əˈbaʊt ˈweɪkɪŋ ʌs bɪˈfɔr ˈsɛvən/
dialogue.zh: 那能不能在七點以前叫醒我們？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The on timer starts the wind at six.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ɑn ˈtaɪmər stɑrts ðə wɪnd æt sɪks/
dialogue.zh: 開機定時會準六點送出風。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: On and off timers share the same key?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn ænd ɔf ˈtaɪmərz ʃɛr ðə seɪm ki/
dialogue.zh: 開機和關機定時共用同一顆鍵嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, one dot for on, one for off.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wʌn dɑt fɔr ɑn wʌn fɔr ɔf/
dialogue.zh: 對，開機一個圓點，關機另一個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not mix them, last night we froze.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt mɪks ðɛm læst naɪt wi froʊz/
dialogue.zh: 別弄混了，昨晚我們冷到發抖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We set the on time by mistake again.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi sɛt ði ɑn taɪm baɪ mɪsˈteɪk əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 我們又不小心設成開機的時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What happens if power dies mid timer?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ˈhæpənz ɪf ˈpaʊər daɪz mɪd ˈtaɪmər/
dialogue.zh: 定時跑到一半跳電會怎麼樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It forgets, so check the dot at night.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt fərˈɡɛts soʊ tʃɛk ðə dɑt æt naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 它會忘記，睡前再確認那個圓點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tiny dots hide in a dark bedroom.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtaɪni dɑts haɪd ɪn ə dɑrk ˈbɛdˌrum/
dialogue.zh: 小圓點在黑黑的臥室裡根本看不見。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use your phone light, then I can see.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz jʊr foʊn laɪt ðɛn aɪ kən si/
dialogue.zh: 用手機的燈照一下，我就看得到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A timer beats a whole night of wind.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈtaɪmər bits ə hoʊl naɪt ʌv wɪnd/
dialogue.zh: 用定時比吹整夜要好得多。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your chest feels better with a break.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr tʃɛst filz ˈbɛtər wɪð ə breɪk/
dialogue.zh: 讓冷氣歇一下，胸口會比較舒服。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Half an hour is too short for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf ən ˈaʊər ɪz tu ʃɔrt fɔr mi/
dialogue.zh: 半小時對我來說太短了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I wake sweating after two hours anyway.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ weɪk ˈswɛtɪŋ ˈæftər tu ˈaʊərz ˈɛniˌweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 反正我吹兩小時後還是會熱醒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then step it up in half hour blocks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn stɛp ɪt ʌp ɪn hæf ˈaʊər blɑks/
dialogue.zh: 那就半小時半小時往上加。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Each press adds thirty minutes, nothing more.
dialogue.phonetic: /itʃ prɛs ædz ˈθɜrti ˈmɪnɪts ˈnʌθɪŋ mɔr/
dialogue.zh: 每按一次加三十分，不會再多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the fan rest when the timer ends?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə fæn rɛst wɛn ðə ˈtaɪmər ɛndz/
dialogue.zh: 定時結束的時候風扇也會停嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Everything stops, one beep, then silence.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvriθɪŋ stɑps wʌn bip ðɛn ˈsaɪləns/
dialogue.zh: 全部停下來，嗶一聲，然後無聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That sudden silence is the hard part.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈsʌdən ˈsaɪləns ɪz ðə hɑrd pɑrt/
dialogue.zh: 突然安靜下來的那一刻最難熬。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Room warms fast once the wind dies.
dialogue.phonetic: /rum wɔrmz fæst wʌns ðə wɪnd daɪz/
dialogue.zh: 風一停，房間一下就回溫了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Open the window then, let the night in.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊpən ðə ˈwɪndoʊ ðɛn lɛt ðə naɪt ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 那個時候開窗，讓夜的涼氣進來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cooler outside after two in the morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkulər ˌaʊtˈsaɪd ˈæftər tu ɪn ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 凌晨兩點以後外面比較涼了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Make it a habit before you lie down.
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪk ɪt ə ˈhæbɪt bɪˈfɔr ju laɪ daʊn/
dialogue.zh: 把設定時變成躺下前的習慣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three taps, one number, then the dot.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri tæps wʌn ˈnʌmbər ðɛn ðə dɑt/
dialogue.zh: 按三下、一個數字、出現圓點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That dot means it waits while the wind runs.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt dɑt minz ɪt weɪts waɪl ðə wɪnd rʌnz/
dialogue.zh: 那個點代表定時在等，風還在吹。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It counts down from the hour you chose.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt kaʊnts daʊn frʌm ði ˈaʊər ju tʃoʊz/
dialogue.zh: 它從你選的那個小時往下倒數。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Show me the countdown, I like to see it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃoʊ mi ðə ˈkaʊntˌdaʊn aɪ laɪk tə si ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 讓我看倒數，我喜歡看到它。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It shows for a while, then the number fades.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ʃoʊz fɔr ə waɪl ðɛn ðə ˈnʌmbər feɪdz/
dialogue.zh: 它先亮一下，數字之後就淡掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cancel it if I wake in the middle.
dialogue.phonetic: /kænˈsɛl ɪt ɪf aɪ weɪk ɪn ðə ˈmɪdəl/
dialogue.zh: 如果我半夜醒來就把它取消。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Press off twice and the dot disappears.
dialogue.phonetic: /prɛs ɔf twaɪs ænd ðə dɑt ˌdɪsəˈpɪrz/
dialogue.zh: 關機鍵按兩次，圓點就會消失。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sleep mode and timer are not the same thing.
dialogue.phonetic: /slip moʊd ænd ˈtaɪmər ər nɑt ðə seɪm θɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 睡眠模式和定時關機不是一回事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sleep only lifts the number, never stops.
dialogue.phonetic: /slip ˈoʊnli lɪfts ðə ˈnʌmbər ˈnɛvər stɑps/
dialogue.zh: 睡眠模式只把溫度拉高，不會關機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Use both, cool gently then switch off.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz boʊθ kul ˈdʒɛntli ðɛn swɪtʃ ɔf/
dialogue.zh: 兩個一起用，先慢慢涼再關掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That pair saves power and my throat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt pɛr seɪvz ˈpaʊər ænd maɪ θroʊt/
dialogue.zh: 這種搭配省電，也救了我的喉嚨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will the unit start again by itself?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ði ˈjunɪt stɑrt əˈɡɛn baɪ ɪtˈsɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 關了以後它會自己重新啟動嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, off means off until you press on.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ɔf minz ɔf ʌnˈtɪl ju prɛs ɑn/
dialogue.zh: 不會，關了就等你再按開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My phone alarm rings at six anyway.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ foʊn əˈlɑrm rɪŋz æt sɪks ˈɛniˌweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 反正我手機鬧鐘六點會響。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the timer has no job after six.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðə ˈtaɪmər hæz noʊ dʒɑb ˈæftər sɪks/
dialogue.zh: 那六點以後定時就不必做事了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Night after night, the same two hours.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪt ˈæftər naɪt ðə seɪm tu ˈaʊərz/
dialogue.zh: 一夜接一夜，同樣的兩個小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Write the plan on the small wall chart.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ðə plæn ɑn ðə smɔl wɔl tʃɑrt/
dialogue.zh: 把這計畫寫在牆上那張小表。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A chart helps the children remember too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə tʃɑrt hɛlps ðə ˈtʃɪldrən rɪˈmɛmbər tu/
dialogue.zh: 有表格，小孩也比較記得住。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They press the remote, so keep it high.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ prɛs ðə rɪˈmoʊt soʊ kip ɪt haɪ/
dialogue.zh: 他們會亂按遙控器，要放高一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: High shelf, out of small reaching hands.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ ʃɛlf aʊt ʌv smɔl ˈritʃɪŋ hændz/
dialogue.zh: 放高架子，小孩的手夠不到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we need a step stool to reach it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi nid ə stɛp stul tə ritʃ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那我們就要搬小凳子才拿得到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lock key solves that little problem.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɑk ki sɑlvz ðæt ˈlɪtəl ˈprɑbləm/
dialogue.zh: 鎖定鍵就能解決那個小問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lock it at night, unlock at breakfast.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɑk ɪt æt naɪt ˌʌnˈlɑk æt ˈbrɛkfəst/
dialogue.zh: 睡前鎖上，吃早餐時再解開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the timer survive a power cut?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə ˈtaɪmər sərˈvaɪv ə ˈpaʊər kʌt/
dialogue.zh: 跳電以後定時還會存在嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most models lose it, check the morning dot.
dialogue.phonetic: /moʊst ˈmɑdəlz luz ɪt tʃɛk ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ dɑt/
dialogue.zh: 多數機型會忘掉，早上查一下圓點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our old machine restarts on its own.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər oʊld məˈʃin ˌrisˈtɑrts ɑn ɪts oʊn/
dialogue.zh: 我們那台舊機會自己重新開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That wastes power all through the day.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt weɪsts ˈpaʊər ɔl θru ðə deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 那樣一整天都在浪費電。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A smart plug fixes that for little money.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə smɑrt plʌɡ ˈfɪksɪz ðæt fɔr ˈlɪtəl ˈmʌni/
dialogue.zh: 一個定時插座花不了多少錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Set it once and it keeps the plan.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛt ɪt wʌns ænd ɪt kips ðə plæn/
dialogue.zh: 設定一次，它就照你的計畫開關。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Plug it in where the cord reaches.
dialogue.phonetic: /plʌɡ ɪt ɪn wɛr ðə kɔrd ˈritʃɪz/
dialogue.zh: 插在電線碰得到的那個插座。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The wall socket sits behind the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə wɔl ˈsɑkɪt sɪts bɪˈhaɪnd ðə dɔr/
dialogue.zh: 牆上的插座在門的後面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No extension cord, the current is strong.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ɪkˈstɛnʃən kɔrd ðə ˈkɜrənt ɪz strɔŋ/
dialogue.zh: 別用延長線，冷氣的電流很強。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thick wire only, ask the hardware shop.
dialogue.phonetic: /θɪk ˈwaɪər ˈoʊnli æsk ðə ˈhɑrdˌwɛr ʃɑp/
dialogue.zh: 只用粗線，去五金行問一聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thin wire melts and the smell turns bad.
dialogue.phonetic: /θɪn ˈwaɪər mɛlts ænd ðə smɛl tɜrnz bæd/
dialogue.zh: 細線會熔化，味道也會變壞。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, we write that on the shopping list.
dialogue.phonetic: /gʊd wi raɪt ðæt ɑn ðə ˈʃɑpɪŋ lɪst/
dialogue.zh: 好，把粗線寫進購物的清單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What hour do we leave the house?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ˈaʊər du wi liv ðə haʊs/
dialogue.zh: 我們早上幾點出門？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eight, so set the off time for seven.
dialogue.phonetic: /eɪt soʊ sɛt ði ɔf taɪm fɔr ˈsɛvən/
dialogue.zh: 八點，所以關機設在七點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cooling until seven costs very little.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkulɪŋ ʌnˈtɪl ˈsɛvən kɔsts ˈvɛri ˈlɪtəl/
dialogue.zh: 涼到七點用不了多少電。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Night power is cheaper than daytime power.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪt ˈpaʊər ɪz ˈtʃipər ðæn ˈdeɪˌtaɪm ˈpaʊər/
dialogue.zh: 夜裡的電價比白天便宜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who told you about the night rate?
dialogue.phonetic: /hu toʊld ju əˈbaʊt ðə naɪt reɪt/
dialogue.zh: 誰告訴你夜間費率的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The man who reads our meter each spring.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə mæn hu ridz ˈaʊər ˈmitər itʃ sprɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 每年春天來讀電表的那位先生。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ask him about the rate when he comes.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk hɪm əˈbaʊt ðə reɪt wɛn hi kʌmz/
dialogue.zh: 等他來的時候問問那個費率。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will write the questions on a note.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl raɪt ðə ˈkwɛstʃənz ɑn ə noʊt/
dialogue.zh: 我先把要問的寫在一張紙條上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A note helps, my memory runs thin.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə noʊt hɛlps maɪ ˈmɛməri rʌnz θɪn/
dialogue.zh: 寫紙條有用，我的記性很薄。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The big question is about the shut off hour.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɪɡ ˈkwɛstʃən ɪz əˈbaʊt ðə ʃʌt ɔf ˈaʊər/
dialogue.zh: 最該問的是關機時間會不會失效。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does a long timer hurt the machine?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ə lɔŋ ˈtaɪmər hɜrt ðə məˈʃin/
dialogue.zh: 定時拉得很長會傷害機器嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, starts and stops wear it more.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ stɑrts ænd stɑps wɛr ɪt mɔr/
dialogue.zh: 不會，一直開開關關才更耗損。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then one long block beats five short ones.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wʌn lɔŋ blɑk bits faɪv ʃɔrt wʌnz/
dialogue.zh: 那一次長時段勝過五次短的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sleep with one shut off, not many.
dialogue.phonetic: /slip wɪð wʌn ʃʌt ɔf nɑt ˈmɛni/
dialogue.zh: 睡覺只設一個關機點，別設一堆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Set it and place the remote face down.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛt ɪt ænd pleɪs ðə rɪˈmoʊt feɪs daʊn/
dialogue.zh: 設好以後把遙控器翻過來放。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Why face down? The screen stays dark then.
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ feɪs daʊn ðə skrin steɪz dɑrk ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 為什麼要翻過去？螢幕就不亮了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No light in your eyes, no waking up.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ laɪt ɪn jʊr aɪz noʊ ˈweɪkɪŋ ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 眼睛照不到光，就比較不會醒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: True, I wake at any small glow.
dialogue.phonetic: /tru aɪ weɪk æt ˈɛni smɔl ɡloʊ/
dialogue.zh: 真的，我有一點亮光就會睜開眼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Black tape hides the lamp on the unit.
dialogue.phonetic: /blæk teɪp haɪdz ðə læmp ɑn ði ˈjunɪt/
dialogue.zh: 黑膠帶能貼掉主機上的指示燈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only the lamp, never the air holes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ðə læmp ˈnɛvər ði ɛr hoʊlz/
dialogue.zh: 只能貼燈，千萬別蓋住出風孔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Blocked holes make the motor work harder.
dialogue.phonetic: /blɑkt hoʊlz meɪk ðə ˈmoʊtər wɜrk ˈhɑrdər/
dialogue.zh: 堵住孔會讓馬達更吃力和更熱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So tape there, and nothing else.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ teɪp ðɛr ænd ˈnʌθɪŋ ɛls/
dialogue.zh: 所以只在那顆燈上貼膠帶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Morning sun wakes us anyway at six.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɔrnɪŋ sʌn weɪks ʌs ˈɛniˌweɪ æt sɪks/
dialogue.zh: 六點的太陽還是會叫我們起床。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the timer has done its job well.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðə ˈtaɪmər hæz dʌn ɪts dʒɑb wɛl/
dialogue.zh: 那定時就已經盡完了它的任務。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Five hours feels safer for a hot night.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv ˈaʊərz filz ˈseɪfər fɔr ə hɑt naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 很熱的那種夜設五小時比較保險。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the beep wakes no one, it just stops.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðə bip weɪks noʊ wʌn ɪt dʒʌst stɑps/
dialogue.zh: 那聲嗶不會吵醒誰，它只是停下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My dog barks when the wind goes away.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ dɔɡ bɑrks wɛn ðə wɪnd ɡoʊz əˈweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 風一停，我的狗就開始叫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Leave the hall light, the floor stays cool.
dialogue.phonetic: /liv ðə hɔl laɪt ðə flɔr steɪz kul/
dialogue.zh: 留著客廳的燈，地板還有涼氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cement floors keep cold until sunrise.
dialogue.phonetic: /səˈmɛnt flɔrz kip koʊld ʌnˈtɪl ˈsʌnˌraɪz/
dialogue.zh: 水泥地會把涼留到日出。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put a rug there, his belly gets cold.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊt ə rʌɡ ðɛr hɪz ˈbɛli ɡɛts koʊld/
dialogue.zh: 那裡鋪一塊地毯，他肚子會冷。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Set the clock on the remote tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛt ðə klɑk ɑn ðə rɪˈmoʊt təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 今晚把遙控器的時間調準。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It shows the hour the machine shuts down.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ʃoʊz ði ˈaʊər ði məˈʃin ʃʌts daʊn/
dialogue.zh: 它會告訴你幾點自動關機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A wind smell at dawn means the timer failed.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə wɪnd smɛl æt dɔn minz ðə ˈtaɪmər fɛld/
dialogue.zh: 天亮還有風聲，就代表定時沒生效。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then check three things before we sleep.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn tʃɛk θri θɪŋz bɪˈfɔr wi slip/
dialogue.zh: 那睡之前就要查三樣東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Write them by the bed lamp, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ðɛm baɪ ðə bɛd læmp pliz/
dialogue.zh: 請把那三樣寫在床頭燈旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Clean filter, new battery, working timer.
dialogue.phonetic: /klin ˈfɪltər nju ˈbætəri ˈwɜrkɪŋ ˈtaɪmər/
dialogue.zh: 濾網乾淨、電池是新的、定時會運作。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Switch it off before you open the panel.
dialogue.phonetic: /swɪtʃ ɪt ɔf bɪˈfɔr ju ˈoʊpən ðə ˈpæənəl/
dialogue.zh: 打開面板以前先把它關掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Unplug it too, wet hands and power.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌʌnˈplʌɡ ɪt tu wɛt hændz ænd ˈpaʊər/
dialogue.zh: 也把插頭拔了，溼手不能碰電。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lift the front cover, then pull it toward you.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɪft ðə frʌnt ˈkʌvər ðɛn pʊl ɪt təˈwɔrd ju/
dialogue.zh: 抬起前蓋，再往自己的方向拉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It sticks on the right clip a bit.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt stɪks ɑn ðə raɪt klɪp ə bɪt/
dialogue.zh: 右邊那個卡榫有一點卡住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two thin meshes sit under that cover.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu θɪn ˈmɛʃɪz sɪt ˈʌndər ðæt ˈkʌvər/
dialogue.zh: 那蓋子下面有兩片薄薄的網。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pull each one up, then slide it out.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊl itʃ wʌn ʌp ðɛn slaɪd ɪt aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 先把每片往上抬，再抽出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Whoa, a cloud of dust just rose.
dialogue.phonetic: /waʊ ə klaʊd ʌv dʌst dʒʌst roʊz/
dialogue.zh: 哇，剛才是有一團灰塵飛起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold them outside, the room will fill up.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ðɛm ˌaʊtˈsaɪd ðə rum wɪl fɪl ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 在外面處理吧，不然房間全是灰。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Take them to the balcony, not the bathroom.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ðɛm tə ðə ˈbælkəni nɑt ðə ˈbæθrum/
dialogue.zh: 拿到陽台洗，不要拿到浴室。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bathroom sink is easier, the water is warm.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbæθrum sɪŋk ɪz ˈizər ðə ˈwɔtər ɪz wɔrm/
dialogue.zh: 浴室的水槽比較方便，水也是溫的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Vacuum the thick layer first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈvækˌjum ðə θɪk ˈleɪər fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 先用吸塵器吸掉厚的那一層。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use the brush part, or the mesh tears.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ðə brʌʃ pɑrt ɔr ðə mɛʃ tɪrz/
dialogue.zh: 要裝毛刷那頭，不然網會破。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now run warm water through the mesh.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ rʌn wɔrm ˈwɔtər θru ðə mɛʃ/
dialogue.zh: 現在用溫水從後面穿過網子沖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: From the clean side, push the dirt out.
dialogue.phonetic: /frʌm ðə klin saɪd pʊʃ ðə dɜrt aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 從乾淨那一面把髒東西推出去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not use hot water on plastic.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt juz hɑt ˈwɔtər ɑn ˈplæstɪk/
dialogue.zh: 塑膠網不能用熱水沖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It warps, and then the panel will not close.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt wɔrps ænd ðɛn ðə ˈpæənəl wɪl nɑt kloʊz/
dialogue.zh: 會變形，然後面板就蓋不起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A soft brush takes the grey film away.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə sɔft brʌʃ teɪks ðə ɡreɪ fɪlm əˈweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 軟毛刷就能把那層灰膜刷掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Scrub along the lines, never across.
dialogue.phonetic: /skrʌb əˈlɔŋ ðə laɪnz ˈnɛvər əˈkrɔs/
dialogue.zh: 要順著紋路刷，別橫著刷。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A drop of dish soap is enough.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə drɑp ʌv dɪʃ soʊp ɪz ɪˈnʌf/
dialogue.zh: 滴一滴洗碗精就夠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rinse it twice more, no foam left.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪns ɪt twaɪs mɔr noʊ foʊm lɛft/
dialogue.zh: 再多沖兩次，不能留泡泡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Never squeeze the mesh like a shirt.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɛvər skwiz ðə mɛʃ laɪk ə ʃɜrt/
dialogue.zh: 千萬別像擰衣服那樣擰濾網。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Shake off water and stand them up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃeɪk ɔf ˈwɔtər ænd stænd ðɛm ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 甩一甩水，讓它們直著立起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Drying takes a whole morning in shade.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdraɪɪŋ teɪks ə hoʊl ˈmɔrnɪŋ ɪn ʃeɪd/
dialogue.zh: 陰著晾乾要花一整個上午。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sun cracks the plastic, shade is safer here.
dialogue.phonetic: /sʌn kræks ðə ˈplæstɪk ʃeɪd ɪz ˈseɪfər hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 太陽會曬裂塑膠，陰乾比較安全。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Put them back only when fully dry.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊt ðɛm bæk ˈoʊnli wɛn ˈfʊli draɪ/
dialogue.zh: 全乾了才能把它們裝回去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A wet mesh brings the smell back again.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə wɛt mɛʃ brɪŋz ðə smɛl bæk əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 網子沒乾，機裡面又會發臭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How often must we clean these meshes?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈɔfən mʌst wi klin ðiz ˈmɛʃɪz/
dialogue.zh: 這些濾網多久要清一次？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two weeks in summer, once in winter.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu wikz ɪn ˈsʌmər wʌns ɪn ˈwɪntər/
dialogue.zh: 夏天兩週一次，冬天一季一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our red lamp says it is overdue.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər rɛd læmp sɛz ɪt ɪz ˌoʊvərˈdu/
dialogue.zh: 我們的紅燈說已經超過期限了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Reset it after the panels go back.
dialogue.phonetic: /riˈsɛt ɪt ˈæftər ðə ˈpæənəlz ɡoʊ bæk/
dialogue.zh: 面板裝好以後再把燈歸零。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which button clears that cleaning sign?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ ˈbʌtən klɪrz ðæt ˈklinɪŋ saɪn/
dialogue.zh: 哪一顆鍵會清掉那個清洗記號？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold the quiet key for five seconds.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ðə ˈkwaɪət ki fɔr faɪv ˈsɛkəndz/
dialogue.zh: 長按安靜鍵五秒就可以了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There, the red dot went dark.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ðə rɛd dɑt wɛnt dɑrk/
dialogue.zh: 看到了，那個紅點熄掉了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, now the panel and the screws.
dialogue.phonetic: /gʊd naʊ ðə ˈpæənəl ænd ðə skruz/
dialogue.zh: 好，接著是面板和小螺絲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One screw fell behind the bed again.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn skru fɛl bɪˈhaɪnd ðə bɛd əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 有一顆螺絲又掉到床後面了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Magnet on the tip, it jumps right up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmæɡnɪt ɑn ðə tɪp ɪt dʒʌmps raɪt ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 起子頭貼一塊磁鐵，它就吸上來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep that screw in a small cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ðæt skru ɪn ə smɔl kʌp/
dialogue.zh: 那顆螺絲先收在小杯子裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tape the cup under the machine table.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪp ðə kʌp ˈʌndər ðə məˈʃin ˈteɪbəl/
dialogue.zh: 把杯子用膠帶黏在桌底。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This grey mesh washes many times.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ɡreɪ mɛʃ ˈwɑʃɪz ˈmɛni taɪmz/
dialogue.zh: 這片灰網可以反覆水洗很多次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That white part holds powder, never wash it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt waɪt pɑrt hoʊldz ˈpaʊdər ˈnɛvər wɑʃ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 白色那片裡麵包的是除臭粉，不能洗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why? It looks like the same mesh.
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ ɪt lʊks laɪk ðə seɪm mɛʃ/
dialogue.zh: 為什麼？看起來跟那網子一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Water kills the powder, then it does nothing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɔtər kɪlz ðə ˈpaʊdər ðɛn ɪt dʌz ˈnʌθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 水會破壞那層粉，它就變成裝飾了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long does that white part last?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ dʌz ðæt waɪt pɑrt læst/
dialogue.zh: 那片白色的能用多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One hot season, then we buy a new one.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn hɑt ˈsizən ðɛn wi baɪ ə nju wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 一個炎熱的季節，之後就要換新。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See the size printed on the frame edge.
dialogue.phonetic: /si ðə saɪz ˈprɪntɪd ɑn ðə freɪm ɛdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 看框框邊緣印的尺寸。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Model number and filter number, two lines.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɑdəl ˈnʌmbər ænd ˈfɪltər ˈnʌmbər tu laɪnz/
dialogue.zh: 一行是機種號碼，一行是濾網號碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Order them online, the shop has none.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔrdər ðɛm ˈɑnˌlaɪn ðə ʃɑp hæz nʌn/
dialogue.zh: 上網訂吧，附近的店沒有賣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our neighbor sells a box of spares.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər ˈneɪbər sɛlz ə bɑks ʌv spɛrz/
dialogue.zh: 鄰居那邊有一盒備用的在賣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A spare mesh saves a sticky night.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə spɛr mɛʃ seɪvz ə ˈstɪki naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 備用網能救一個黏熱的夜晚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Buy two, wash one while one works.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ tu wɑʃ wʌn waɪl wʌn wɜrks/
dialogue.zh: 買兩片，一片在機器裡，一片晾著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Never run the machine without a mesh.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɛvər rʌn ðə məˈʃin wɪˈðaʊt ə mɛʃ/
dialogue.zh: 沒有濾網絕對不要讓它運轉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dust goes deep into the machine then.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌst ɡoʊz dip ˈɪntu ðə məˈʃin ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 那樣灰塵會直接跑進機器深處。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The fan blade throws dust everywhere.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə fæn bled θroʊz dʌst ˈɛvriˌwɛr/
dialogue.zh: 風扇葉片會把灰甩得到處都是。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the metal fins get a dirty coat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə ˈmɛtəl fɪnz ɡɛt ə ˈdɜrti koʊt/
dialogue.zh: 裡面的金屬鰭片也會蒙上一層髒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A dirty inside makes the bill climb.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈdɜrti ɪnˈsaɪd meɪks ðə bɪl klaɪm/
dialogue.zh: 裡面越髒，電費就往上爬。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So washing mesh is a money saver.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ˈwɑʃɪŋ mɛʃ ɪz ə ˈmʌni ˈseɪvər/
dialogue.zh: 所以洗濾網其實是在省錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My sneezing gets better after a wash.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈsnizɪŋ ɡɛts ˈbɛtər ˈæftər ə wɑʃ/
dialogue.zh: 洗完以後我比較不打噴嚏了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same for the sheets, wash them hot.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm fɔr ðə ʃits wɑʃ ðɛm hɑt/
dialogue.zh: 床單也是，那要用熱水洗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Inside the slats, a black line sits.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪnˈsaɪd ðə slæts ə blæk laɪn sɪts/
dialogue.zh: 風葉縫裡有一條黑黑的線。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wipe them with a long dry brush.
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪp ðɛm wɪð ə lɔŋ draɪ brʌʃ/
dialogue.zh: 用長長的乾刷子伸進去掃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not spray water on the buttons.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt spreɪ ˈwɔtər ɑn ðə ˈbʌtənz/
dialogue.zh: 不要朝按鍵那邊噴水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A barely wet cloth on the case only.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈbɛrli wɛt klɔθ ɑn ðə keɪs ˈoʊnli/
dialogue.zh: 外殼用微濕的布擦就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One clip broke, the cover hangs loose.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn klɪp broʊk ðə ˈkʌvər hæŋz lus/
dialogue.zh: 一個卡榫斷了，蓋子垂著快掉了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two tape strips hold it until Sunday.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu teɪp strɪps hoʊld ɪt ʌnˈtɪl ˈsʌndeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 先貼兩條膠帶撐到星期天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That clip is cheap, the shop has bins.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt klɪp ɪz tʃip ðə ʃɑp hæz bɪnz/
dialogue.zh: 那種卡榫很便宜，五金行整箱在賣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take the broken one and match the shape.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ðə ˈbroʊkən wʌn ænd mætʃ ðə ʃeɪp/
dialogue.zh: 把斷掉那顆帶去對形狀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mesh torn at the corner, can tape fix it?
dialogue.phonetic: /mɛʃ tɔrn æt ðə ˈkɔrnər kæn teɪp fɪks ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 網子角上破了，膠帶能補嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, a tear grows wider in a week.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ə tɛr ɡroʊz ˈwaɪdər ɪn ə wik/
dialogue.zh: 不行，一週內破口會越撕越大。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Order a new mesh tonight, then.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔrdər ə nju mɛʃ təˈnaɪt ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 那就今晚先把新網訂下去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sleep with the old one, it still works.
dialogue.phonetic: /slip wɪð ði oʊld wʌn ɪt stɪl wɜrks/
dialogue.zh: 今晚先用舊的，還吹得出風。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fresh mesh makes the wind sound lighter.
dialogue.phonetic: /frɛʃ mɛʃ meɪks ðə wɪnd saʊnd ˈlaɪtər/
dialogue.zh: 換了新網，風聲聽起來比較輕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the cold comes out sooner too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə koʊld kʌmz aʊt ˈsunər tu/
dialogue.zh: 涼風也比較快就吹出來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cooling works better with clean air paths.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkulɪŋ wɜrks ˈbɛtər wɪθ klin ɛr pæθs/
dialogue.zh: 風路乾淨，冷氣的效率比較好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Set the timer again, you moved the plugs.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛt ðə ˈtaɪmər əˈɡɛn ju muvd ðə plʌɡz/
dialogue.zh: 定時重設一下，你剛拔過插頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right, the dot is back on the screen.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ðə dɑt ɪz bæk ɑn ðə skrin/
dialogue.zh: 對了，螢幕上圓點回來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two hours, then we see how we sleep.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈaʊərz ðɛn wi si haʊ wi slip/
dialogue.zh: 設兩小時，看看這樣睡得好不好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Grey marks cover the white shell now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪ mɑrks ˈkʌvər ðə waɪt ʃɛl naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 白色外殼現在全都是灰手印。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wipe with a cloth and a drop of soap.
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪp wɪð ə klɔθ ænd ə drɑp ʌv soʊp/
dialogue.zh: 用布加一點洗碗精擦一擦。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Never climb on the chair for that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɛvər klaɪm ɑn ðə tʃɛr fɔr ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 別為了擦外殼爬椅子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The step stool reaches the top edge.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə stɛp stul ˈritʃɪz ðə tɑp ɛdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 用那張小凳就夠到上面了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Water leaked on my cleaned floor today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɔtər likt ɑn maɪ klint flɔr təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 今天有水漏在我剛擦過的地板上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the drain tube, not the tray.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə dreɪn tub nɑt ðə treɪ/
dialogue.zh: 是從排水管漏的，不是水盤溢出。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where does that white tube end up?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr dʌz ðæt waɪt tub ɛnd ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 那根白管子通到哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Outside near the balcony floor drain.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌaʊtˈsaɪd nɪr ðə ˈbælkəni flɔr dreɪn/
dialogue.zh: 外面，陽台排水孔旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A blocked drain sends water back inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə blɑkt dreɪn sɛndz ˈwɔtər bæk ɪnˈsaɪd/
