dialogue.zh: 排水孔塞住，水就會倒灌回屋裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Blow air through it, or call the man.
dialogue.phonetic: /bloʊ ɛr θru ɪt ɔr kɔl ðə mæn/
dialogue.zh: 用氣吹通它，不然就得叫師傅。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which man? The repair shop guy?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ mæn ðə rɪˈpɛr ʃɑp ɡaɪ/
dialogue.zh: 哪一位？修理店的那個人嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The one who fills the cooling gas.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə wʌn hu fɪlz ðə ˈkulɪŋ ɡæs/
dialogue.zh: 就是幫冷氣補冷媒的那位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe next week, the mesh is clean now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi nɛkst wik ðə mɛʃ ɪz klin naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 也許下週再約，濾網先弄好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, tonight we only enjoy cool wind.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs təˈnaɪt wi ˈoʊnli ɪnˈdʒɔɪ kul wɪnd/
dialogue.zh: 對，今晚就先享受涼風吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Smell the wind, is that smell gone?
dialogue.phonetic: /smɛl ðə wɪnd ɪz ðæt smɛl gɔn/
dialogue.zh: 聞一下風，那個味道不見了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Gone, only a light clean smell now.
dialogue.phonetic: /gɔn ˈoʊnli ə laɪt klin smɛl naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 不見了，只有一點乾淨的氣味。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next time we split the job in two.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst taɪm wi splɪt ðə dʒɑb ɪn tu/
dialogue.zh: 下次把工作分成兩半。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I open and wash, you hang and dry.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈoʊpən ænd wɑʃ ju hæŋ ænd draɪ/
dialogue.zh: 我拆和洗，你負責晾乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, and nobody stands on the chair.
dialogue.phonetic: /gʊd ænd ˈnoʊbədi stændz ɑn ðə tʃɛr/
dialogue.zh: 好，也沒人要站在椅子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That chair still wears a dusty print.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt tʃɛr stɪl wɛrz ə ˈdʌsti prɪnt/
dialogue.zh: 那張椅子還留著昨天的灰印。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Put the next cleaning on the wall chart.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊt ðə nɛkst ˈklinɪŋ ɑn ðə wɔl tʃɑrt/
dialogue.zh: 把下次清洗寫進牆上那張表。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will set the phone to remind us.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl sɛt ðə foʊn tə rɪˈmaɪnd ʌs/
dialogue.zh: 我把手機鬧鐘設好提醒我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done for tonight, the room smells fresh.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn fɔr təˈnaɪt ðə rum smɛlz frɛʃ/
dialogue.zh: 今晚收工，房間聞起來很乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sleep well, tomorrow the bill arrives.
dialogue.phonetic: /slip wɛl təˈmɑroʊ ðə bɪl əˈraɪvz/
dialogue.zh: 好好睡，明天電費單會送到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The paper bill came in the mail today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈpeɪpər bɪl keɪm ɪn ðə mel təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 今天信箱裡收到了紙本電費單。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Read the number aloud, I cannot look yet.
dialogue.phonetic: /rid ðə ˈnʌmbər əˈlaʊd aɪ ˈkɑnɑt lʊk jɛt/
dialogue.zh: 把金額唸出來，我還不敢看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One thousand two hundred for last month.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈθaʊzənd tu ˈhʌndrəd fɔr læst mʌnθ/
dialogue.zh: 上個月是一千兩百塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Summer always takes the biggest bite.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌmər ˈɔlweɪz teɪks ðə ˈbɪɡɪst baɪt/
dialogue.zh: 夏天總是咬得最凶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Whose name stands on this account?
dialogue.phonetic: /huz neɪm stændz ɑn ðɪs əˈkaʊnt/
dialogue.zh: 這戶戶名寫的是誰？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The landlord, we only pay the use.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈlændˌlɔrd wi ˈoʊnli peɪ ði juz/
dialogue.zh: 房東的名字，我們只付使用的那部分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much of it is the air conditioner?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ ʌv ɪt ɪz ði ɛr kənˈdɪʃənər/
dialogue.zh: 裡面有多少是冷氣吃掉的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About a third in July and August.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈbaʊt ə θɜrd ɪn dʒʊˈlaɪ ænd ˈɔɡəst/
dialogue.zh: 七月和八月大約佔三分之一。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who pays for the machine in our lease?
dialogue.phonetic: /hu peɪz fɔr ðə məˈʃin ɪn ˈaʊər lis/
dialogue.zh: 契約裡說冷氣誰付？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use is ours, repairs are his.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ɪz ˈaʊərz rɪˈpɛrz ər hɪz/
dialogue.zh: 電費是我們付，修理是房東付。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then a broken part is not my money.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ə ˈbroʊkən pɑrt ɪz nɑt maɪ ˈmʌni/
dialogue.zh: 那壞掉的零件不用我出錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask him first, or he will not refund.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk hɪm fɜrst ɔr hi wɪl nɑt riˈfʌnd/
dialogue.zh: 要先問他，不然他不退給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Split the bill with your roommate tonight?
dialogue.phonetic: /splɪt ðə bɪl wɪð jʊr ˈrumˌmeɪt təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 今晚要跟室友一起分賬嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He takes the cooling, we split the rest.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi teɪks ðə ˈkulɪŋ wi splɪt ðə rɛst/
dialogue.zh: 他認冷氣那部分，剩下的我們平分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That math sounds fair to me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt mæθ saʊndz fɛr tə mi/
dialogue.zh: 這個算法我覺得公平。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Write it down before we forget again.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ɪt daʊn bɪˈfɔr wi fərˈɡɛt əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 先寫下來，別又像上次忘掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He runs the cooling all day in there.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi rʌnz ðə ˈkulɪŋ ɔl deɪ ɪn ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 他整天在自己房裡開冷氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then ask him to close that door tight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn æsk hɪm tə kloʊz ðæt dɔr taɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那就請他把房門關緊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: An open door cools the hallway too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ən ˈoʊpən dɔr kuls ðə ˈhɔlˌweɪ tu/
dialogue.zh: 門開著，連走廊都在吹冷氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is money flying out the window.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ˈmʌni ˈflaɪɪŋ aʊt ðə ˈwɪndoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 那等於錢從窗戶飛出去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What does each unit of power cost?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt dʌz itʃ ˈjunɪt ʌv ˈpaʊər kɔst/
dialogue.zh: 一度電多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three steps, the high step is steep.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri stɛps ðə haɪ stɛp ɪz stip/
dialogue.zh: 費率分三級，最後一級很貴。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Steep how? Tell me a real number.
dialogue.phonetic: /stip haʊ tɛl mi ə ril ˈnʌmbər/
dialogue.zh: 多貴？給我一個真正的數字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nearly twice the first step price.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɪrli twaɪs ðə fɜrst stɛp praɪs/
dialogue.zh: 差不多是第一級的兩倍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twice? Then we must watch the fan.
dialogue.phonetic: /twaɪs ðɛn wi mʌst wɑtʃ ðə fæn/
dialogue.zh: 兩倍？那我們得盯著用電。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep the summer under the second step.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ðə ˈsʌmər ˈʌndər ðə ˈsɛkənd stɛp/
dialogue.zh: 整個夏天都別超過第二級。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The app shows today's use in blocks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði æp ʃoʊz təˈdeɪz juz ɪn blɑks/
dialogue.zh: 手機程式把今天的用電切成方塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Green blocks mean we are still safe.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡrin blɑks min wi ər stɪl seɪf/
dialogue.zh: 綠色方塊代表我們還在安全線。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yesterday the last block turned red.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈjɛstərˌdeɪ ðə læst blɑk tɜrnd rɛd/
dialogue.zh: 昨天最後一塊變成紅色了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That was the storm and the long shower.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʌz ðə stɔrm ænd ðə lɔŋ ˈʃaʊər/
dialogue.zh: 那是暴風雨加上洗很久的澡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Show me the hour when power spiked.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃoʊ mi ði ˈaʊər wɛn ˈpaʊər spaɪkt/
dialogue.zh: 給我看用電衝高的那個小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Seven at night, dinner and dishes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛvən æt naɪt ˈdɪnər ænd ˈdɪʃɪz/
dialogue.zh: 晚上七點，晚飯加上洗碗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dinner uses more than the whole bedroom?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdɪnər ˈjuzɪz mɔr ðæn ðə hoʊl ˈbɛdˌrum/
dialogue.zh: 吃頓飯比整個臥室用電還多？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your cold box runs more than you think.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr koʊld bɑks rʌnz mɔr ðæn ju θɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 你那台冰箱比你以為的更耗電。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mine sits almost empty these days.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn sɪts ˈɔlmoʊst ˈɛmpti ðiz deɪz/
dialogue.zh: 我那台這些天幾乎是空的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A full box holds cold better, you know.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə fʊl bɑks hoʊldz koʊld ˈbɛtər ju noʊ/
dialogue.zh: 冰箱塞滿反而比較保冷，你知道嗎。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So a few bottles help the motor.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ə fju ˈbɑtəlz hɛlp ðə ˈmoʊtər/
dialogue.zh: 那放幾瓶水也能幫它省電。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same trick for the freezer drawer.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm trɪk fɔr ðə ˈfrizər drɔr/
dialogue.zh: 冷凍抽屜也可以用同一招。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Last summer we paid far more, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /læst ˈsʌmər wi peɪd fɑr mɔr raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 去年夏天我們付得多很多，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ninety more, because the baby room ran.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnaɪnti mɔr bɪˈkɔz ðə ˈbeɪbi rum ræn/
dialogue.zh: 多了九十塊，因為寶寶房的冷氣沒停過。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ninety more is a whole vacation dinner.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnaɪnti mɔr ɪz ə hoʊl veˈkeɪʃən ˈdɪnər/
dialogue.zh: 多那些錢夠吃一整頓度假晚餐了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This year the timer saves us early.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs jɪr ðə ˈtaɪmər seɪvz ʌs ˈɜrli/
dialogue.zh: 今年定時很早就在幫我們省。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Late fees exist? We paid one once.
dialogue.phonetic: /leɪt fiz ɪɡˈzɪst wi peɪd wʌn wʌns/
dialogue.zh: 有遲繳費嗎？我們付過一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pay by the fifteenth and it is clean.
dialogue.phonetic: /peɪ baɪ ðə fɪfˈtinθ ænd ɪt ɪz klin/
dialogue.zh: 十五號以前繳，就不會有罰金。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do we pay, the corner store?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr du wi peɪ ðə ˈkɔrnər stɔr/
dialogue.zh: 在哪裡繳費，巷口的超商嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The machine inside takes the paper slip.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə məˈʃin ɪnˈsaɪd teɪks ðə ˈpeɪpər slɪp/
dialogue.zh: 裡面那台機器會讀繳費單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep the receipt, it proves the date.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ðə rɪˈsit ɪt pruvz ðə deɪt/
dialogue.zh: 收據要留著，它證明繳費日期。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A photo is enough, the paper fades.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈfoʊtoʊ ɪz ɪˈnʌf ðə ˈpeɪpər feɪdz/
dialogue.zh: 拍照就行，熱感紙會不見字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our landlady asks for rent on the first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər ˈlændˌleɪdi æsks fɔr rɛnt ɑn ðə fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 房東太太要求一號繳房租。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then move the power day to the third.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn muv ðə ˈpaʊər deɪ tə ðə θɜrd/
dialogue.zh: 那電費往後挪到三號繳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two days apart, my wallet breathes.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu deɪz əˈpɑrt maɪ ˈwɑlɪt brithz/
dialogue.zh: 錯開兩天，我的錢包才能呼吸。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A phone reminder keeps both dates safe.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə foʊn rɪˈmaɪndər kips boʊθ deɪts seɪf/
dialogue.zh: 手機鬧鐘會幫我們守住這兩個日期。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does a fan cost less than the cold box?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ə fæn kɔst lɛs ðæn ðə koʊld bɑks/
dialogue.zh: 電扇比冰箱更省電嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A fan costs almost nothing an hour.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə fæn kɔsts ˈɔlmoʊst ˈnʌθɪŋ ən ˈaʊər/
dialogue.zh: 電扇吹一小時幾乎不花錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the air conditioner per hour?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ði ɛr kənˈdɪʃənər pɜr ˈaʊər/
dialogue.zh: 那冷氣一小時要多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Like ten times a fan, maybe more.
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪk tɛn taɪmz ə fæn ˈmeɪbi mɔr/
dialogue.zh: 大約是電扇的十倍，可能更多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten times! So every single hour counts.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn taɪmz soʊ ˈɛvri ˈsɪŋɡəl ˈaʊər kaʊnts/
dialogue.zh: 十倍！那每一小時都要緊了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cut one hour and the bill softens.
dialogue.phonetic: /kʌt wʌn ˈaʊər ænd ðə bɪl ˈsɔfənz/
dialogue.zh: 少吹一個小時，賬單就會軟下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our friend pays with solar panels.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər frɛnd peɪz wɪθ ˈsoʊlər ˈpæənəlz/
dialogue.zh: 我們朋友家用太陽能板付電費。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: His roof faces south and gets sun.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪz rʊf ˈfeɪsɪz saʊθ ænd ɡɛts sʌn/
dialogue.zh: 他的屋頂朝南，整天有太陽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our roof holds the neighbor's birds.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər rʊf hoʊldz ðə ˈneɪbərz bɜrdz/
dialogue.zh: 我們的屋頂只站著鄰居的鳥。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So keep the fan plan, it works fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ kip ðə fæn plæn ɪt wɜrks faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 那就繼續用電扇的搭配法，很有效。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about the machine in the living room?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt əˈbaʊt ðə məˈʃin ɪn ðə ˈlɪvɪŋ rum/
dialogue.zh: 那客廳那台主機呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It drinks more, the room is twice size.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt drɪŋks mɔr ðə rum ɪz twaɪs saɪz/
dialogue.zh: 那台吃電更多，客廳有兩倍大。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twice the room, twice the money, then.
dialogue.phonetic: /twaɪs ðə rum twaɪs ðə ˈmʌni ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 兩倍的空間，就要花兩倍的錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Close that door when we eat in here.
dialogue.phonetic: /kloʊz ðæt dɔr wɛn wi it ɪn hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 在這裡吃飯時把那扇門關起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our small room cools in fifteen minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər smɔl rum kuls ɪn fɪfˈtin ˈmɪnɪts/
dialogue.zh: 我們這小房間十五分鐘就涼了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then shut it off and enjoy the rest.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ʃʌt ɪt ɔf ænd ɪnˈdʒɔɪ ðə rɛst/
dialogue.zh: 那就關掉，享受剩下的涼意。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who keeps the paper slips, you or me?
dialogue.phonetic: /hu kips ðə ˈpeɪpər slɪps ju ɔr mi/
dialogue.zh: 繳費單據誰收，你還是我？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A box under the bed, all fourteen months.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə bɑks ˈʌndər ðə bɛd ɔl ˈfɔrˈtin mʌnθs/
dialogue.zh: 床底下那個盒子，十四個月的都在。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fourteen? We never throw anything away.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɔrˈtin wi ˈnɛvər θroʊ ˈɛniθɪŋ əˈweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 十四個月？我們什麼都捨不得丟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep one year, the rest can go now.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip wʌn jɪr ðə rɛst kæn ɡoʊ naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 留一年的，其他的現在可以丟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ask the landlady about the repair cost.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk ðə ˈlændˌleɪdi əˈbaʊt ðə rɪˈpɛr kɔst/
dialogue.zh: 修理費要問房東太太。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She said the machine is still under warranty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi sɛd ðə məˈʃin ɪz stɪl ˈʌndər ˈwɔrənti/
dialogue.zh: 她說那台還在保固裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Warranty? Then the gas is free.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɔrənti ðɛn ðə ɡæs ɪz fri/
dialogue.zh: 保固？那加冷媒不用錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only inside the first two years.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ɪnˈsaɪd ðə fɜrst tu jɪrz/
dialogue.zh: 只有在頭兩年裡面才算。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We bought it the spring before rain.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi bɔt ɪt ðə sprɪŋ bɪˈfɔr reɪn/
dialogue.zh: 那是下大雨之前那個春天買的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then check the box, find the receipt.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn tʃɛk ðə bɑks faɪnd ði rɪˈsit/
dialogue.zh: 那就翻紙箱，找購買的收據。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Receipts live in the shoe box, I think.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪˈsits lɪv ɪn ðə ʃu bɑks aɪ θɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 收據應該都在鞋盒裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Top shelf, behind the winter slippers.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɑp ʃɛlf bɪˈhaɪnd ðə ˈwɪntər ˈslɪpərz/
dialogue.zh: 在最上層，冬季拖鞋後面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Found it, two years and four months.
dialogue.phonetic: /faʊnd ɪt tu jɪrz ænd fɔr mʌnθs/
dialogue.zh: 找到了，兩年四個月。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So the fan motor is ours to pay.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðə fæn ˈmoʊtər ɪz ˈaʊərz tə peɪ/
dialogue.zh: 所以風扇馬達的錢要我們自己出。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fair, we did leave the window open.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛr wi dɪd liv ðə ˈwɪndoʊ ˈoʊpən/
dialogue.zh: 合理，是我們自己把窗開著的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not tell that part to the landlady.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt tɛl ðæt pɑrt tə ðə ˈlændˌleɪdi/
dialogue.zh: 這部分先別跟房東太太說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a fee for the visit first?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ə fi fɔr ðə ˈvɪzɪt fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 上門檢查要先收一筆費用嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask the shop, they quote on the phone.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk ðə ʃɑp ðeɪ kloʊt ɑn ðə foʊn/
dialogue.zh: 打電話問店家，他們會口頭報價。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I will call in the morning light.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ wɪl kɔl ɪn ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ laɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那我天亮時打電話去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, the bill can wait, the room cannot.
dialogue.phonetic: /gʊd ðə bɪl kæn weɪt ðə rum ˈkɑnɑt/
dialogue.zh: 好，電費單能等，房間不能等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Money talks, but the room comes first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmʌni tɔks bʌt ðə rum kʌmz fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 錢要算，可是房間要先涼下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Agreed, tomorrow we both make calls.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈɡrid təˈmɑroʊ wi boʊθ meɪk kɔlz/
dialogue.zh: 同意，明天我們兩個都打電話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: First the shop, then the power office.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɜrst ðə ʃɑp ðɛn ðə ˈpaʊər ˈɔfɪs/
dialogue.zh: 先打給冷氣行，再打給電力公司。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Write the questions on that same note.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ðə ˈkwɛstʃənz ɑn ðæt seɪm noʊt/
dialogue.zh: 把問題寫在同一張紙條上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The note grew long, like a shopping list.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə noʊt ɡru lɔŋ laɪk ə ˈʃɑpɪŋ lɪst/
dialogue.zh: 紙條越寫越長，像購物清單。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sleep now, morning has plenty of calls.
dialogue.phonetic: /slip naʊ ˈmɔrnɪŋ hæz ˈplɛnti ʌv kɔlz/
dialogue.zh: 先睡吧，早上還有一堆電話要打。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One call for the gas, one for the leak.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn kɔl fɔr ðə ɡæs wʌn fɔr ðə lik/
dialogue.zh: 一通問冷媒，一通問漏水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both go to the same shop, I think.
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ ɡoʊ tə ðə seɪm ʃɑp aɪ θɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 兩件事應該找同一家店。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, now the fan noise finally rests.
dialogue.phonetic: /gʊd naʊ ðə fæn nɔɪz ˈfaɪnəli rɛsts/
dialogue.zh: 好，今晚讓吵人的風聲休息。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Close your eyes, the cool will hold till dawn.
dialogue.phonetic: /kloʊz jʊr aɪz ðə kul wɪl hoʊld tɪl dɔn/
dialogue.zh: 閉眼睛吧，涼意撐得到天亮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tomorrow bring the phone near the meter.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈmɑroʊ brɪŋ ðə foʊn nɪr ðə ˈmitər/
dialogue.zh: 明天把手機拿到電表附近。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will film the number, then we check together.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl fɪlm ðə ˈnʌmbər ðɛn wi tʃɛk təˈɡɛðər/
dialogue.zh: 我把那個數字拍下來，再一起對。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wind blows, but nothing feels cold.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪnd bloʊz bʌt ˈnʌθɪŋ filz koʊld/
dialogue.zh: 風還在吹，可是完全不涼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It ran fine all of last week.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ræn faɪn ɔl ʌv læst wik/
dialogue.zh: 上整個禮拜都還很正常。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Outside, the metal box hums like always.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌaʊtˈsaɪd ðə ˈmɛtəl bɑks hʌmz laɪk ˈɔlˌweɪz/
dialogue.zh: 外面那台鐵盒子還是一樣嗡嗡叫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yet the pipes feel warm to my hand.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛt ðə paɪps fil wɔrm tə maɪ hænd/
dialogue.zh: 可是管線摸起來是溫的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Warm pipes mean little cooling gas left.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔrm paɪps min ˈlɪtəl ˈkulɪŋ ɡæs lɛft/
dialogue.zh: 管子溫的就是裡面的冷媒不多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is that the gas inside these thin pipes?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt ðə ɡæs ɪnˈsaɪd ðiz θɪn paɪps/
dialogue.zh: 就是那幾根細管裡面的氣體嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, and it leaks out very slowly.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ænd ɪt likz aʊt ˈvɛri ˈsloʊli/
dialogue.zh: 對，它會非常慢慢地漏光。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Where? I see drops near the wall joint.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr aɪ si drɑps nɪr ðə wɔl dʒɔɪnt/
dialogue.zh: 哪裡？牆角接頭那邊有水珠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A leak leaves oily dust stuck there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə lik livz ˈɔɪli dʌst stʌk ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 漏的地方會有油油的黑灰黏住。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So the dirt shows us the escaping gas.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðə dɜrt ʃoʊz ʌs ði ɪˈskeɪpɪŋ ɡæs/
dialogue.zh: 所以那些髒污就指出氣體跑掉的位置。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We need a man with the right tools.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi nid ə mæn wɪð ðə raɪt tulz/
dialogue.zh: 我們需要一個帶對工具的師傅。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The card on the fridge has a phone number.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kɑrd ɑn ðə frɪdʒ hæz ə foʊn ˈnʌmbər/
dialogue.zh: 冰箱上那張名片就有電話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Call now, or the line gets busy.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɔl naʊ ɔr ðə laɪn ɡɛts ˈbɪzi/
dialogue.zh: 現在打吧，不然線路會壅塞。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine in the morning is the best time.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn ɪn ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ ɪz ðə bɛst taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 早上九點打電話最好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They ask the model and the year.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ æsk ðə ˈmɑdəl ænd ði jɪr/
dialogue.zh: 他們會問機型和出廠年份。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Read it from the sticker under the cover.
dialogue.phonetic: /rid ɪt frʌm ðə ˈstɪkər ˈʌndər ðə ˈkʌvər/
dialogue.zh: 唸蓋子下面那張標籤上的字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The label reads spring, twenty twenty three.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈleɪbəl ridz sprɪŋ ˈtwɛnti ˈtwɛnti θri/
dialogue.zh: 標籤寫的是二零二三年的春天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two years old, so still a young machine.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu jɪrz oʊld soʊ stɪl ə jʌŋ məˈʃin/
dialogue.zh: 才兩年，算是很年輕的機器。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ask if a visit costs less this week.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk ɪf ə ˈvɪzɪt kɔsts lɛs ðɪs wik/
dialogue.zh: 問問這週出車費有沒有比較便宜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They said a check up fee first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ sɛd ə tʃɛk ʌp fi fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 他們說先收一趟檢查費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A check up fee, then the real price.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə tʃɛk ʌp fi ðɛn ði ril praɪs/
dialogue.zh: 檢查費先算，之後才是真正的價。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He counts it into the final bill.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi kaʊnts ɪt ˈɪntu ðə ˈfaɪnəl bɪl/
dialogue.zh: 那筆會折進最後的總額裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Morning or afternoon for the visit?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɔrnɪŋ ɔr ˌæftərˈnun fɔr ðə ˈvɪzɪt/
dialogue.zh: 要約上午還是下午來？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Morning, before the sun heats the outside box.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɔrnɪŋ bɪˈfɔr ðə sʌn hits ði ˌaʊtˈsaɪd bɑks/
dialogue.zh: 上午，趁外面那台被曬熱之前。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Friday slots are full, says the man.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfraɪdeɪ slɑts ər fʊl sɛz ðə mæn/
dialogue.zh: 接電話的說星期五已經排滿了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Saturday then, we are home all day.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsætərˌdeɪ ðɛn wi ər hoʊm ɔl deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 那就星期六，我們整天都在家。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Saturday work costs a little extra.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsætərˌdeɪ wɜrk kɔsts ə ˈlɪtəl ˈɛkstrə/
dialogue.zh: 週末到場會多加一點費用。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Worth it, a hot room is no fun.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɜrθ ɪt ə hɑt rum ɪz noʊ fʌn/
dialogue.zh: 值得的，熱死的房間一點都不好玩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Write our address and the floor number.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ˈaʊər əˈdrɛs ænd ðə flɔr ˈnʌmbər/
dialogue.zh: 把我們的地址和樓層寫下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Gate code too, the truck needs the lane.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡeɪt koʊd tu ðə trʌk nidz ðə leɪn/
dialogue.zh: 社區密碼也給，貨車要開進巷道。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He asked for a photo of the label.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi æskt fɔr ə ˈfoʊtoʊ ʌv ðə ˈleɪbəl/
dialogue.zh: 他要一張標籤的照片。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Send mine, the light in the room is bad.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛnd maɪn ðə laɪt ɪn ðə rum ɪz bæd/
dialogue.zh: 發我拍的這張，這裡光線太差。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, he comes at ten sharp.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ hi kʌmz æt tɛn ʃɑrp/
dialogue.zh: 好，他十點整到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then clear the shoes by the front door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn klɪr ðə ʃuz baɪ ðə frʌnt dɔr/
dialogue.zh: 那先把玄關的鞋子收乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He needs room around the outside box.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi nidz rum əˈraʊnd ði ˌaʊtˈsaɪd bɑks/
dialogue.zh: 外面機台周圍要留空間給他。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Move the flower pots and the long broom.
dialogue.phonetic: /muv ðə ˈflaʊər pɑts ænd ðə lɔŋ brum/
dialogue.zh: 把花盆和那支長掃把移開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The ladder goes against the fence, not the box.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈlædər ɡoʊz əˈɡɛnst ðə fɛns nɑt ðə bɑks/
dialogue.zh: 梯子要靠在圍籬上，不能靠機台。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, the thin metal sides dent fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ðə θɪn ˈmɛtəl saɪdz dɛnt fæst/
dialogue.zh: 說得對，機台的鐵皮一靠就凹。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ten o'clock, a van stops at the gate.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛn əˈklɑk ə væn stɑps æt ðə ɡeɪt/
dialogue.zh: 十點整，一輛車停在門口。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He wears boots and carries a big case.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi wɛrz buts ænd ˈkæriz ə bɪɡ keɪs/
dialogue.zh: 他穿套鞋，提著一個大工具箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we look at his work badge first?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi lʊk æt hɪz wɜrk bædʒ fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 要不要先看他的員工識別證？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He already shows the shop name on the van.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi ɔlˈrɛdi ʃoʊz ðə ʃɑp neɪm ɑn ðə væn/
dialogue.zh: 車身上就印著冷氣行的名字了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: First he touches the flap, then the pipes.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɜrst hi ˈtʌtʃɪz ðə flæp ðɛn ðə paɪps/
dialogue.zh: 他先摸風葉，再去摸管線。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He asks how long the warm wind stayed.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi æsks haʊ lɔŋ ðə wɔrm wɪnd steɪd/
dialogue.zh: 他問不涼的情況持續多久了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Say two weeks, and the smell first.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪ tu wikz ænd ðə smɛl fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 就說兩週，還有之前那股味道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He nods and points at the white tube.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi nɑdz ænd pɔɪnts æt ðə waɪt tub/
dialogue.zh: 他點點頭，指著那根白管子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That tube carries water out of the room.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt tub ˈkæriz ˈwɔtər aʊt ʌv ðə rum/
dialogue.zh: 那根管子負責把水排到外面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dirt plugs it, so the tray overflows.
dialogue.phonetic: /dɜrt plʌɡz ɪt soʊ ðə treɪ ˌoʊvəˈfloʊz/
dialogue.zh: 髒東西塞住了，所以水盤會滿出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He blows the tube clear with air.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi bloʊz ðə tub klɪr wɪð ɛr/
dialogue.zh: 他用空氣把那根管子吹通。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then he opens the case of tools.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn hi ˈoʊpənz ðə keɪs ʌv tulz/
dialogue.zh: 接著才打開那箱工具。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two round dials connect to the pipes.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu raʊnd ˈdaɪəlz kəˈnɛkt tə ðə paɪps/
dialogue.zh: 兩個圓圓的表接到管線上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They read the pressure inside the loop.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ rid ðə ˈprɛʃər ɪnˈsaɪd ðə lup/
dialogue.zh: 那讀的是回路裡面的壓力。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Low pressure tells him the gas is gone.
dialogue.phonetic: /loʊ ˈprɛʃər tɛlz hɪm ðə ɡæs ɪz gɔn/
dialogue.zh: 壓力低就代表冷媒跑光了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He must find the leak before filling.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi mʌst faɪnd ðə lik bɪˈfɔr ˈfɪlɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 他一定要先抓漏，才灌新的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Filling without a fix wastes our money.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɪlɪŋ wɪˈðaʊt ə fɪks weɪsts ˈaʊər ˈmʌni/
dialogue.zh: 不補洞就灌，只是浪費我們的錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He smears soap water on every joint.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi smɪrz soʊp ˈwɔtər ɑn ˈɛvri dʒɔɪnt/
dialogue.zh: 他把肥皂水抹在每一個接頭上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bubbles grow where the gas slips out.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbʌbəlz ɡroʊ wɛr ðə ɡæs slɪps aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 氣泡長起來的地方就是漏氣點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There, one tiny bubble at the bend.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr wʌn ˈtaɪni ˈbʌbəl æt ðə bɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 看那邊，彎管那裡有一個小泡泡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can he seal that bend today?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn hi sil ðæt bɛnd təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 他今天能把那個彎處補起來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He needs a new short piece of copper.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi nidz ə nju ʃɔrt pis ʌv ˈkɑpər/
dialogue.zh: 他要換一小段新的銅管。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Copper pipe, he has one in the van.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɑpər paɪp hi hæz wʌn ɪn ðə væn/
dialogue.zh: 銅管啊，他車上就有一卷。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we wait, he works fast in shade.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi weɪt hi wɜrks fæst ɪn ʃeɪd/
dialogue.zh: 那我們就等，他在陰影下動作很快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Water for him, the day is hot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɔtər fɔr hɪm ðə deɪ ɪz hɑt/
dialogue.zh: 請師傅喝杯水吧，天氣太熱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring the cold tea, he looks thirsty.
dialogue.phonetic: /brɪŋ ðə koʊld ti hi lʊks ˈθɜrsti/
dialogue.zh: 把冰茶拿出來，他看起來很渴。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He says our filter mesh was part of it.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi sɛz ˈaʊər ˈfɪltər mɛʃ wʌz pɑrt ʌv ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 他說濾網太髒也是原因之一。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dust on the mesh starves the cold.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌst ɑn ðə mɛʃ stɑrvz ðə koʊld/
dialogue.zh: 網上的灰會讓冷氣出不來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Starves? Explain that word, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɑrvz ɪkˈspleɪn ðæt wɜrd pliz/
dialogue.zh: 讓冷氣餓死？請解釋那個詞。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Less air moves, so the pipes stay warm.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛs ɛr muvz soʊ ðə paɪps steɪ wɔrm/
dialogue.zh: 通過的空氣變少，管子就一直溫溫的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So the cleaning was part of the fix.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðə ˈklinɪŋ wʌz pɑrt ʌv ðə fɪks/
dialogue.zh: 所以清潔本身就是修理的一環。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He wiped the fins too, look how bright.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi waɪpt ðə fɪnz tu lʊk haʊ braɪt/
dialogue.zh: 他也擦了鰭片，你看多亮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the dials read much higher.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə ˈdaɪəlz rid mʌtʃ ˈhaɪər/
dialogue.zh: 現在兩個表的數字高很多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cool wind in two minutes, feel this.
dialogue.phonetic: /kul wɪnd ɪn tu ˈmɪnɪts fil ðɪs/
dialogue.zh: 兩分鐘後就出涼風了，你摸。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cold at last, my shoulders dropped.
dialogue.phonetic: /koʊld æt læst maɪ ˈʃoʊldərz drɑpt/
dialogue.zh: 終於涼了，我的肩膀都鬆下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give him the quote paper, then pay.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɪv hɪm ðə kloʊt ˈpeɪpər ðɛn peɪ/
dialogue.zh: 把他寫的報價單拿來看，再付錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: His note lists gas, seal, and labor.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪz noʊt lɪsts ɡæs sil ænd ˈleɪbər/
dialogue.zh: 他列了冷媒、焊補和工資。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Add the check up fee we paid first.
dialogue.phonetic: /æd ðə tʃɛk ʌp fi wi peɪd fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 再加上我們先付的檢查費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three thousand in all, cash or app?
dialogue.phonetic: /θri ˈθaʊzənd ɪn ɔl kæʃ ɔr æp/
dialogue.zh: 總共三千塊，現金還是用轉帳？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: App is faster, he shows a square code.
dialogue.phonetic: /æp ɪz ˈfæstər hi ʃoʊz ə skwɛr koʊd/
dialogue.zh: 掃碼比較快，他拿出一個付款碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Scan it, and write the job number.
dialogue.phonetic: /skæn ɪt ænd raɪt ðə dʒɑb ˈnʌmbər/
dialogue.zh: 掃一下，再把單號寫下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, the receipt lives in your phone now.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn ðə rɪˈsit lɪvz ɪn jʊr foʊn naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 好了，收據現在存在你手機裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the work carry a promise too?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə wɜrk ˈkæri ə ˈprɑmɪs tu/
dialogue.zh: 這次修的工有沒有保固？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ninety days on the seal he placed.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnaɪnti deɪz ɑn ðə sil hi pleɪst/
dialogue.zh: 他補的那個點保九十天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ninety days, if it leaks again?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnaɪnti deɪz ɪf ɪt likz əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 九十天的話，再漏怎麼算？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One phone call, he comes back free.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn foʊn kɔl hi kʌmz bæk fri/
dialogue.zh: 打一通電話，他免費回來處理。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ask him what makes these pipes freeze.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk hɪm wʌt meɪks ðiz paɪps friz/
dialogue.zh: 順便問他管子為什麼會結霜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Water drops or frost both mean trouble.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɔtər drɑps ɔr frɔst boʊθ min ˈtrʌbəl/
dialogue.zh: 滴水或結霜都代表有問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our kitchen pipe wore frost last night.
dialogue.phonetic: /aʊr ˈkɪtʃən paɪp wɔr frɔst læst naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我們廚房那根管子昨晚結了霜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He will look again next Thursday then.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi wɪl lʊk əˈɡɛn nɛkst ˈθɜrzˌdeɪ ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 那他下個星期四再來看一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Too soon? Old machines hide more problems.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu sun oʊld məˈʃinz haɪd mɔr ˈprɑbləmz/
dialogue.zh: 那麼快？老機器都還藏著別的毛病。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Write Thursday and the noise list too.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ˈθɜrzˌdeɪ ænd ðə nɔɪz lɪst tu/
dialogue.zh: 把星期四和那些怪聲音都寫下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He leaves his receipt sheet on the table.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi livz hɪz rɪˈsit ʃit ɑn ðə ˈteɪbəl/
dialogue.zh: 他把收據單留在桌上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put it in the box with the bills.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊt ɪt ɪn ðə bɑks wɪð ðə bɪlz/
dialogue.zh: 放進那盒收據裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Same box as the electric slips?
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm bɑks æz ði ɪˈlɛktrɪk slɪps/
dialogue.zh: 跟電費單同一個盒子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, money papers sleep in one place.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈmʌni ˈpeɪpərz slip ɪn wʌn pleɪs/
dialogue.zh: 對，金錢的紙都睡在同一個地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the room is cool, the man is gone.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə rum ɪz kul ðə mæn ɪz gɔn/
dialogue.zh: 房間涼了，師傅也走了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let him park closer next time, though.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt hɪm pɑrk ˈkloʊsər nɛkst taɪm ðoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 不過下次要讓他停近一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our balcony floor has a new scratch.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər ˈbælkəni flɔr hæz ə nju skrætʃ/
dialogue.zh: 我們陽台地板多了一道刮痕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small price for a cold night, I say.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɔl praɪs fɔr ə koʊld naɪt aɪ seɪ/
dialogue.zh: 換一晚涼快，這個代價算小。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sleep with both windows shut tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /slip wɪð boʊθ ˈwɪndoʊz ʃʌt təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 今晚兩扇窗都關著睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The gas is in, the cool will stay.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ɡæs ɪz ɪn ðə kul wɪl steɪ/
dialogue.zh: 冷媒補好了，涼會留得住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rain all day, the air feels cold.
dialogue.phonetic: /reɪn ɔl deɪ ði ɛr filz koʊld/
dialogue.zh: 整天在下雨，空氣摸起來冷冷的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We wore our jackets at home today.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi wɔr ˈaʊər ˈdʒækəts æt hoʊm təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 今天我們在家裡也穿著外套。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Turn the machine to heat tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɜrn ðə məˈʃin tə hit təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 今晚把冷氣機切到暖氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The sun shape, is that the warm one?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə sʌn ʃeɪp ɪz ðæt ðə wɔrm wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 那個太陽圖案，是暖氣那一個嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, that sun brings the warm wind.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðæt sʌn brɪŋz ðə wɔrm wɪnd/
dialogue.zh: 對，太陽圖示吹的就是暖風。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Press it and wait, nothing blows yet.
dialogue.phonetic: /prɛs ɪt ənd weɪt ˈnʌθɪŋ bloʊz jɛt/
dialogue.zh: 按下去等一等，現在還吹不出風。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why so slow? Cold wind only.
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ soʊ sloʊ koʊld wɪnd ˈoʊnli/
dialogue.zh: 怎麼這麼慢？只吹出冷風。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Heat needs five minutes to wake up.
dialogue.phonetic: /hit nidz faɪv ˈmɪnɪts tə weɪk ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 暖氣需要五分鐘才會醒過來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Five minutes is a long cold wait.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv ˈmɪnɪts ɪz ə lɔŋ koʊld weɪt/
dialogue.zh: 等暖氣這五分鐘，冷得難熬。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put socks on, the floor draws heat.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊt sɑks ɑn ðə flɔr drɔz hit/
dialogue.zh: 先穿襪子，地板會把熱抽走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now warmth comes out gentle and low.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ wɔrmθ kʌmz aʊt ˈdʒɛntəl ənd loʊ/
dialogue.zh: 暖風現在輕輕地、慢慢地吹出來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Point the flap down, warm air climbs.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɔɪnt ðə flæp daʊn wɔrm ɛr klaɪmz/
dialogue.zh: 把風向板往下壓，暖氣會往上昇。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Down it goes, like you said.
dialogue.phonetic: /daʊn ɪt goʊz laɪk ju sɛd/
dialogue.zh: 好，風朝下了，就像你剛才說的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now the whole room fills evenly.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə hoʊl rum fɪlz ˈivənli/
dialogue.zh: 現在整個房間暖得均勻了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twenty one feels right on the skin.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti wʌn filz raɪt ɑn ðə skɪn/
dialogue.zh: 設在二十一度，皮膚覺得剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep it under twenty three, heat is costly.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ɪt ˈʌndər ˈtwɛnti θri hit ɪz ˈkɑstli/
dialogue.zh: 別超過二十三度，暖氣很貴。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Costly how? Heat drinks more than cool?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɑstli haʊ hit drɪŋks mɔr ðæn kul/
dialogue.zh: 貴在哪裡？暖氣比冷氣更耗電嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One more degree adds a big jump.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr dɪˈɡri ædz ə bɪɡ dʒʌmp/
dialogue.zh: 每多一度，電費就跳上一大截。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then twenty one, and a warm shirt.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ˈtwɛnti wʌn ənd ə wɔrm ʃɜrt/
dialogue.zh: 那就二十一度，再加一件保暖上衣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thick socks too, feet lose heat first.
dialogue.phonetic: /θɪk sɑks tu fit luz hit fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 厚襪子也要，腳最會漏熱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The air feels dry when heat runs.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ɛr filz draɪ wɛn hit rʌnz/
dialogue.zh: 暖氣一開，空氣就覺得很乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A bowl of water by the bed helps.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə boʊl ʌv ˈwɔtər baɪ ðə bɛd hɛlps/
dialogue.zh: 床邊放一盆水就有幫助。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My lips crack and my nose bleeds.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ lɪps kræk ənd maɪ noʊz blidz/
dialogue.zh: 我的嘴唇裂開，鼻子還流過血。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rub cream tonight, and breathe through cloth.
dialogue.phonetic: /rʌb krim təˈnaɪt ənd brið θru klɔθ/
dialogue.zh: 今晚塗乳液，呼吸時隔一塊布。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dry air shocks us on small metal things.
dialogue.phonetic: /draɪ ɛr ʃɑks ʌs ɑn smɔl ˈmɛtəl θɪŋz/
dialogue.zh: 空氣太乾，摸到金屬就被靜電打。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Water in the room stops most of that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɔtər ɪn ðə rum stɑps moʊst ʌv ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 房裡有水氣，靜電就少一大半。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hang a wet towel near the warm flow.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæŋ ə wɛt ˈtaʊəl nɪr ðə wɔrm floʊ/
dialogue.zh: 把濕毛巾掛在暖風附近。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It gives up its water as it dries.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɡɪvz ʌp ɪts ˈwɔtər æz ɪt draɪz/
dialogue.zh: 它一邊變乾，一邊把水還給空氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Warm air also lifts dust from the rug.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔrm ɛr ˈɔlsoʊ lɪfts dʌst frʌm ðə rʌɡ/
dialogue.zh: 暖風也會把地毯上的灰攪起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sweep before you switch on the heat.
dialogue.phonetic: /swip bɪˈfɔr ju swɪtʃ ɑn ðə hit/
dialogue.zh: 開暖氣以前先掃地。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sleeping with a jacket, is that silly?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈslipɪŋ wɪð ə ˈdʒækɪt ɪz ðæt ˈsɪli/
dialogue.zh: 穿著外套睡覺，很傻嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A warm jacket feels like a good hug.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə wɔrm ˈdʒækɪt filz laɪk ə ɡʊd hʌɡ/
dialogue.zh: 穿暖外套睡覺，像被人抱著一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Set the timer for the warm hours.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛt ðə ˈtaɪmər fɔr ðə wɔrm ˈaʊərz/
dialogue.zh: 幫暖氣也訂個關機時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Heat till midnight, then let it rest.
dialogue.phonetic: /hit tɪl ˈmɪdˌnaɪt ðɛn lɛt ɪt rɛst/
dialogue.zh: 暖到半夜，就讓機器休息一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does heat need the timer too?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz hit nid ði ˈtaɪmər tu/
dialogue.zh: 暖氣也要用定時嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, a warm room breaks deep sleep.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ə wɔrm rum breɪks dip slip/
dialogue.zh: 要的，房間太熱會睡不深。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I sleep worse when the air is hot.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ slip wɜrs wɛn ði ɛr ɪz hɑt/
dialogue.zh: 空氣一熱，我睡得就更差。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then set heat low and keep windows shut.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn sɛt hit loʊ ənd kip ˈwɪndoʊz ʃʌt/
dialogue.zh: 那就把暖氣開低，窗戶關緊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No cold wind now, just warm still air.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ koʊld wɪnd naʊ dʒʌst wɔrm stɪl ɛr/
dialogue.zh: 現在沒有冷風，只有靜止的暖氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It feels like a soft blanket, almost.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt filz laɪk ə sɔft ˈblæŋkɪt ˈɔlmoʊst/
dialogue.zh: 幾乎像蓋上一條軟毯子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Frost will come, our window shows it first.
dialogue.phonetic: /frɔst wɪl kʌm ˈaʊər ˈwɪndoʊ ʃoʊz ɪt fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 冬天會結霜，窗子最早告訴我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wipe it with a dry kitchen cloth.
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪp ɪt wɪð ə draɪ ˈkɪtʃən klɔθ/
dialogue.zh: 用乾的廚房抹布把它擦掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The glass sweats when the warm runs hard.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ɡlæs swɛts wɛn ðə wɔrm rʌnz hɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 暖氣猛開時，玻璃會流汗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Open the curtain, sunlight dries the pane.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊpən ðə ˈkɜrtən ˈsʌnlaɪt draɪz ðə peɪn/
dialogue.zh: 拉開窗簾，陽光把玻璃曬乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Machine noise changed, a click inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /məˈʃin nɔɪz tʃeɪndʒd ə klɪk ɪnˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 機器的聲音變了，裡面響了一聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the defrost, quite normal sound.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə diˈfrɔst kwaɪt ˈnɔrməl saʊnd/
dialogue.zh: 那是除霜程序，聲音很平常。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Normal or broken? It clicked twice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɔrməl ɔr ˈbroʊkən ɪt klɪkt twaɪs/
dialogue.zh: 正常還是壞了？它響了兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twice means it melts frost on the outside.
dialogue.phonetic: /twaɪs minz ɪt mɛlts frɔst ɑn ði ˌaʊtˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 響兩次代表它在融掉外機的霜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Water drips there, is that a problem?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɔtər drɪps ðɛr ɪz ðæt ə ˈprɑbləm/
dialogue.zh: 那裡一直在滴水，有問題嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if the little tube freezes shut.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ɪf ðə ˈlɪtəl tub ˈfrizɪz ʃʌt/
dialogue.zh: 只有排水管凍塞住才有事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Blow warm air on the tube, gently.
dialogue.phonetic: /bloʊ wɔrm ɛr ɑn ðə tub ˈdʒɛntli/
dialogue.zh: 用暖風對著管子吹，輕一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, use a cloth soaked in warm water.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ juz ə klɔθ soʊkt ɪn wɔrm ˈwɔtər/
dialogue.zh: 不用，拿熱水泡過的布去捂它。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our last cool night was two days ago.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər læst kul naɪt wʌz tu deɪz əˈɡoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我們最後一個涼爽的夜晚是兩天前。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I miss the cold wind a little.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ mɪs ðə koʊld wɪnd ə ˈlɪtəl/
dialogue.zh: 我其實有點想念那陣冷風。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Miss it in July, when the heat returns.
dialogue.phonetic: /mɪs ɪt ɪn dʒʊˈlaɪ wɛn ðə hit rɪˈtɜrnz/
dialogue.zh: 等到七月你就不會想念它了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: True, tonight I choose the warm side.
dialogue.phonetic: /tru təˈnaɪt aɪ tʃuz ðə wɔrm saɪd/
dialogue.zh: 說得對，今晚我選暖氣這一邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Autumn rain makes the whole house smell wet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔtəm reɪn meɪks ðə hoʊl haʊs smɛl wɛt/
dialogue.zh: 秋天的雨讓整棟房子聞起來潮潮的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Warm air takes the wet out of towels.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔrm ɛr teɪks ðə wɛt aʊt ʌv ˈtaʊəlz/
dialogue.zh: 暖氣會把毛巾裡的濕氣抓走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hang the bath towel in the room, then.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæŋ ðə bæθ ˈtaʊəl ɪn ðə rum ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 那就把洗澡毛巾掛進房間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It drinks the wet and dries by morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt drɪŋks ðə wɛt ənd draɪz baɪ ˈmɔrnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 它吸走濕氣，早上自己就乾了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we cover the machine for winter?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi ˈkʌvər ðə məˈʃin fɔr ˈwɪntər/
dialogue.zh: 冬天要幫機器罩起來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The outside box only, the inside stays bare.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˌaʊtˈsaɪd bɑks ˈoʊnli ði ɪnˈsaɪd steɪz bɛr/
dialogue.zh: 只罩室外機，室內機保持裸著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Buy a cloth cover, not the plastic one.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ ə klɔθ ˈkʌvər nɑt ðə ˈplæstɪk wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 買布罩，別買塑膠的那一種。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Plastic sweats and the box rusts under it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈplæstɪk swɛts ənd ðə bɑks rʌsts ˈʌndər ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 塑膠會凝水，鐵箱在底下生鏽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Clean the mesh one last time today.
dialogue.phonetic: /klin ðə mɛʃ wʌn læst taɪm təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 今天最後清一次濾網。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then dry it fully, mold loves wet storage.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn draɪ ɪt ˈfʊli moʊld lʌvz wɛt ˈstɔrɪdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 然後完全晾乾，黴菌最愛濕的存放處。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Storage? We keep the meshes in the closet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈstɔrɪdʒ wi kip ðə ˈmɛʃɪz ɪn ðə ˈklɑsɪt/
dialogue.zh: 存放？我們把濾網收在衣櫃裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Paper bag them, the shelf dust gets in.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpeɪpər bæɡ ðɛm ðə ʃɛlf dʌst ɡɛts ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 用紙袋裝起來，架子上的灰會掉進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Take the cells out of the remote now.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ðə sɛlz aʊt ʌv ðə rɪˈmoʊt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 現在把電池從遙控器拿出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Leaving them over winter ruins the springs.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlivɪŋ ðɛm ˈoʊvər ˈwɪntər ˈruɪnz ðə sprɪŋz/
dialogue.zh: 放過一整冬，彈簧會生鏽壞掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cold rooms make me eat more at night.
dialogue.phonetic: /koʊld rumz meɪk mi it mɔr æt naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 房間太冷，我晚上吃更多。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Warm soup, then warm feet, then sleep.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔrm sup ðɛn wɔrm fit ðɛn slip/
dialogue.zh: 先喝熱湯，再暖腳，然後睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Heating bills worry my already thin wallet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhitɪŋ bɪlz ˈwɜri maɪ ɔlˈrɛdi θɪn ˈwɑlɪt/
dialogue.zh: 暖氣的電費讓我本就薄的錢包更緊張。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then wear the sweater indoors, like children do.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wɛr ðə ˈswɛtər ɪnˈdɔrz laɪk ˈtʃɪldrən du/
dialogue.zh: 那就像小孩一樣，在室內穿毛衣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sweater, socks, and a low warm setting.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈswɛtər sɑks ənd ə loʊ wɔrm ˈsɛtɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 毛衣、襪子，再加低檔暖氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the cheap way to be cozy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə tʃip weɪ tə bi ˈkoʊzi/
dialogue.zh: 那就是省錢又暖和的做法。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cozy words, but the floor still steals heat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkoʊzi wɜrdz bʌt ðə flɔr stɪl stilz hit/
dialogue.zh: 說得舒服，地板還是一直在偷熱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rugs everywhere, that is my winter plan.
dialogue.phonetic: /rʌɡz ˈɛvriˌwɛr ðæt ɪz maɪ ˈwɪntər plæn/
dialogue.zh: 到處鋪地毯，就是我冬天的計畫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Spring comes back, and we forget all this.
dialogue.phonetic: /sprɪŋ kʌmz bæk ənd wi fərˈɡɛt ɔl ðɪs/
dialogue.zh: 天氣一轉暖，我們就把這些全忘了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we hunt the remote behind the sofa.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi hʌnt ðə rɪˈmoʊt bɪˈhaɪnd ðə ˈsoʊfə/
dialogue.zh: 然後又到沙發後面去找遙控器。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Under the sofa, beside two old coins.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʌndər ðə ˈsoʊfə bɪˈsaɪd tu oʊld kɔɪnz/
dialogue.zh: 就在沙發下，旁邊有兩枚舊硬幣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: New cells again, the same start every summer.
dialogue.phonetic: /nju sɛlz əˈɡɛn ðə seɪm stɑrt ˈɛvri ˈsʌmər/
dialogue.zh: 又換新電池，每年夏天都從這裡開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Year after year, we learn it again.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɪr ˈæftər jɪr wi lɜrn ɪt əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 一年又是一年，我們從頭再學一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One fan, one remote, one long hot season.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn fæn wʌn rɪˈmoʊt wʌn lɔŋ hɑt ˈsizən/
dialogue.zh: 一台電扇、一個遙控器、一個漫長的熱季。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sleep tonight with warm feet and no worries.
dialogue.phonetic: /slip təˈnaɪt wɪð wɔrm fit ənd noʊ ˈwɜriz/
dialogue.zh: 今晚帶著暖腳和無憂去睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The timer counts four hours, soft and warm.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈtaɪmər kaʊnts fɔr ˈaʊərz sɔft ənd wɔrm/
dialogue.zh: 定時倒數四小時，溫和又安靜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four hours of warm, then a dark quiet room.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr ˈaʊərz ʌv wɔrm ðɛn ə dɑrk ˈkwaɪət rum/
dialogue.zh: 暖四小時，然後留一間黑又靜的房。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, the bed holds the rest of the heat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt ðə bɛd hoʊldz ðə rɛst ʌv ðə hit/
dialogue.zh: 正好，床會留住剩下的暖氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Windows closed, curtains drawn, heat inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɪndoʊz kloʊzd ˈkɜrtənz drɔn hit ɪnˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 窗戶關緊，窗簾拉上，暖氣留在家裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That keeps the bill small and us warm.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt kips ðə bɪl smɔl ənd ʌs wɔrm/
dialogue.zh: 這樣電費省，人也暖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more thing, the machine smells warm.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr θɪŋ ðə məˈʃin smɛlz wɔrm/
dialogue.zh: 還有一件事，機器吹出的暖氣有味道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dust burning off, it stops in five minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌst ˈbɜrnɪŋ ɔf ɪt stɑps ɪn faɪv ˈmɪnɪts/
dialogue.zh: 是灰在燒掉，五分鐘就沒味了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, then no more noise tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /gʊd ðɛn noʊ mɔr nɔɪz təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 好，那今晚不再有聲音。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only soft warm air and your slow breathing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli sɔft wɔrm ɛr ənd jʊr sloʊ ˈbriðɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 只有輕輕的暖氣，還有你慢慢的呼吸。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cool days will return, do not worry.
dialogue.phonetic: /kul deɪz wɪl rɪˈtɜrn du nɑt ˈwɜri/
dialogue.zh: 涼的日子還會回來，別擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tomorrow we wash the sheets and rest.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈmɑroʊ wi wɑʃ ðə ʃits ənd rɛst/
dialogue.zh: 明天我們洗床單，然後好好休息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Same work next summer, but softer now.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm wɜrk nɛkst ˈsʌmər bʌt ˈsɔftər naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 明年夏天一樣要折騰，但現在心裡有底了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The machine knows us, we know the machine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə məˈʃin noʊz ʌs wi noʊ ðə məˈʃin/
dialogue.zh: 機器認識我們，我們也認識機器。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now close your eyes, the warm will hold.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ kloʊz jʊr aɪz ðə wɔrm wɪl hoʊld/
dialogue.zh: 現在閉眼睛，暖氣會撐住整夜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good night, cool summer and warm autumn.
dialogue.phonetic: /gʊd naɪt kul ˈsʌmər ənd wɔrm ˈɔtəm/
dialogue.zh: 晚安，涼的夏天和暖的秋天。
